national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Uttar Pradesh government launched the 'Mukhyamantri PRD Cashless Chikitsa Yojana', providing free medical treatment up to Rs 5 lakh annually for Provincial Armed Guard (PRD) personnel and their families, alongside increasing their daily duty allowance from Rs 500 to Rs 600.
• Option A is Incorrect because Rs 2 lakhs is not the approved coverage amount under this specific welfare initiative.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rs 3 lakhs is a distractor figure not associated with the PRD cashless health scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect because Rs 10 lakhs exceeds the financial cap established under the scheme guidelines.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding historical milestones achieved in Test cricket:
1. Rishabh Pant recently became the first Indian player and fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
2. The milestone was achieved during a Test match series against Sri Lanka.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
टेस्ट क्रिकेट में हासिल की गई ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धियों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. ऋषभ पंत हाल ही में टेस्ट क्रिकेट में 100 छक्के लगाने वाले पहले भारतीय खिलाड़ी और दुनिया के चौथे खिलाड़ी बन गए हैं।
2. यह उपलब्धि श्रीलंका के खिलाफ टेस्ट मैच श्रृंखला के दौरान हासिल की गई थी।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because Rishabh Pant achieved the distinction of becoming the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
• Statement 2 is Correct because he accomplished this milestone during the first Test match against Sri Lanka in Galle, making him the fastest to reach the mark in terms of matches played (51st Test).
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is equally valid and correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is accurate.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to institutional mechanisms for fact-finding regarding public protests and law enforcement actions, consider the following statements:
1. High-powered committees established by apex judicial bodies often comprise retired apex court and high court judges along with senior law enforcement experts.
2. Such fact-finding panels are exclusively mandated to investigate financial irregularities in public bodies rather than civil disturbances.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शनों और कानून प्रवर्तन कार्रवाइयों के संबंध में तथ्यान्वेषण (fact-finding) के लिए संस्थागत तंत्र के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. शीर्ष न्यायिक निकायों द्वारा स्थापित उच्च-स्तरीय समितियों में अक्सर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय और उच्च न्यायालय के सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीशों के साथ-साथ वरिष्ठ कानून प्रवर्तन विशेषज्ञ शामिल होते हैं।
2. इस तरह के तथ्यान्वेषण पैनलों को विशेष रूप से नागरिक गड़बड़ी के बजाय सार्वजनिक निकायों में वित्तीय अनियमितताओं की जांच करने का जिम्मा सौंपा जाता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because judicial orders establishing fact-finding committees regarding police or civil disturbances typically constitute panels of retired apex/high court judges, former DGPs, and ex-CBI directors to ensure neutrality.
• Statement 2 is Incorrect because these panels investigate allegations of police excesses, civil rights violations, and public order incidents rather than financial irregularities.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually flawed.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is false.

national_questions.qe: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), often seen in news discussions relating to international trade and compliance challenges with the European Union, functions primarily as which of the following?
national_questions.qh: अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार और यूरोपीय संघ के साथ अनुपालन चुनौतियों के संबंध में चर्चाओं में अक्सर देखे जाने वाले कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज्म (CBAM) का मुख्य रूप से कार्य क्या है?
oe: A direct financial subsidy provided by developing nations to offset carbon footprints of exported goods.
A carbon-sensitive trade framework and border tax adjustment designed by the EU to prevent carbon leakage by equalizing the carbon price on imports.
An international climate treaty replacing the Paris Agreement under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
A mandatory global digital registry for tracking carbon credits traded strictly among private multinational corporations.
oh: निर्यातित वस्तुओं के कार्बन पदचिह्न की भरपाई के लिए विकासशील राष्ट्रों द्वारा प्रदान की जाने वाली प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सब्सिडी।
आयात पर कार्बन मूल्य को बराबर करके कार्बन रिसाव को रोकने के लिए यूरोपीय संघ द्वारा डिज़ाइन किया गया एक कार्बन-संवेदनशील व्यापार ढांचा और सीमा कर समायोजन।
जलवायु परिवर्तन पर संयुक्त राष्ट्र फ्रेमवर्क कन्वेंशन (UNFCCC) के तहत पेरिस समझौते की जगह लेने वाली एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय जलवायु संधि।
विशेष रूप से निजी बहुराष्ट्रीय निगमों के बीच कारोबार किए जाने वाले कार्बन क्रेडिट को ट्रैक करने के लिए एक अनिवार्य वैश्विक डिजिटल रजिस्ट्री।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) acts as a carbon-sensitive trade tool and border adjustment levy that matches the carbon price of imports with domestic production standards, posing compliance challenges and potential double-burden issues for developing trade partners like India.
• Option A is Incorrect because CBAM is not a developing nation subsidy but an import tax/levy imposed by the EU.
• Option C is Incorrect because CBAM is a unilateral trade policy instrument of the EU, not a multilateral climate treaty replacing the Paris Agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect because it is not a corporate carbon credit registry.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to railway infrastructure expansion projects in India, consider the following details regarding the Qadian-Beas broad-gauge railway line project:
1. The project links Qadian in Gurdaspur district with Beas in Amritsar district located in Punjab.
2. The project execution is assigned to Northern Railway and incorporates modern safety deployments like the Kavach train collision avoidance system.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में रेलवे बुनियादी ढांचा विस्तार परियोजनाओं के संदर्भ में, कादियान-ब्यास ब्रॉड-गेज रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित विवरणों पर विचार करें:
1. यह परियोजना पंजाब में स्थित गुरदासपुर जिले के कादियान को अमृतसर जिले के ब्यास से जोड़ती है।
2. परियोजना का निष्पादन उत्तर रेलवे को सौंपा गया है और इसमें कवच ट्रेन टक्कर से बचाव प्रणाली जैसी आधुनिक सुरक्षा प्रणालियां शामिल हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because the approved 39.68 km Qadian-Beas broad-gauge line connects Qadian in Gurdaspur to Beas in Amritsar within Punjab's Majha region.
• Statement 2 is Correct because the project is executed by Northern Railway and explicitly integrates advanced safety infrastructure including the indigenous Kavach train collision avoidance system along with multiple major and minor bridges.
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also valid.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also valid.

national_questions.qe: According to the Directorate of Arecanut and Spices Development (DASD) report for 2025-26, which of the following holds the rank of the largest producer of areca nut (betel nut) globally and domestically within India respectively?
national_questions.qh: अकेलनट एंड स्पाइस डेवलपमेंट निदेशालय (DASD) की 2025-26 की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन क्रमशः विश्व स्तर पर और भारत के भीतर सुपारी (areca nut) का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है?
oe: Vietnam globally and Tamil Nadu domestically
oh: वैश्विक स्तर पर चीन और घरेलू स्तर पर केरल
वैश्विक स्तर पर भारत और घरेलू स्तर पर कर्नाटक
वैश्विक स्तर पर इंडोनेशिया और घरेलू स्तर पर असम
वैश्विक स्तर पर वियतनाम और घरेलू स्तर पर तमिलनाडु
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India leads global areca nut production, accounting for about 63% of total world production in 2025-26, while Karnataka stands as the largest producing state within India, contributing the lion's share of total output.
• Option A is Incorrect because China is not the world leader in areca nut production and Kerala is not India's top producer.
• Option C is Incorrect because Indonesia is not the top global producer in this report and Assam is not the primary domestic state.
• Option D is Incorrect because Vietnam and Tamil Nadu are incorrect regional leaders for this commodity.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the MQ-9B Sea Guardian High Altitude Long Endurance (HALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS):
1. It is leased by the Ministry of Defence primarily to augment the Maritime Domain Awareness and persistent ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) capabilities of the Indian Navy.
2. The platform is manufactured by General Atomics Aeronautical Systems.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
MQ-9B सी गार्डियन हाई एल्टीट्यूड लॉन्ग एंड्योरेंस (HALE) रिमोटली पाइलोटेड एयरक्राफ्ट सिस्टम (RPAS) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. इसे मुख्य रूप से भारतीय नौसेना की समुद्री डोमेन जागरूकता और निरंतर ISR (खुफिया, निगरानी और टोही) क्षमताओं को बढ़ाने के लिए रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा पट्टे पर लिया गया है।
2. यह प्लेटफॉर्म जनरल एटॉमिक्स एयरोनॉटिकल सिस्टम्स द्वारा निर्मित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because the Ministry of Defence contracted to lease MQ-9B Sea Guardian drones specifically for the Indian Navy to boost Maritime Domain Awareness and persistent ISR coverage across the Indian Ocean Region.
• Statement 2 is Correct because these HALE RPAS platforms are manufactured by General Atomics Aeronautical Systems.
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus) Report 2025-26, consider the following statements:
1. The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) reported at the national level is well within the benchmark recommended by the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.
2. The report is compiled and released by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
UDISE+ (यिफाइड डिस्ट्रिक्ट इंफॉर्मेशन सिस्टम फॉर एजुकेशन प्लस) रिपोर्ट 2025-26 के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर रिपोर्ट किया गया समग्र छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (PTR) राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 द्वारा अनुशंसित बेंचमार्क के भीतर है।
2. यह रिपोर्ट कौशल विकास और उद्यमिता मंत्रालय द्वारा संकलित और जारी की जाती है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because the UDISE+ 2025-26 report indicates an overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) of 24:1, which is comfortably within the NEP 2020 recommended benchmark of 30:1.
• Statement 2 is Incorrect because UDISE+ is released by the Ministry of Education (Department of School Education and Literacy), not the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is false.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is false.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the constitutional structure of the Parliament of India, consider the following statements:
1. The Rajya Sabha has a sanctioned maximum strength of up to 250 members, out of which 12 members are nominated by the President from persons having special knowledge or practical experience in literature, science, art, and social service.
2. The Lok Sabha has a maximum constitutional capacity of 550 members, with seats allocated to States and Union Territories based on universal adult suffrage.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत की संसद की संवैधानिक संरचना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. राज्य सभा की अधिकतम स्वीकृत सदस्य संख्या 250 तक है, जिनमें से 12 सदस्यों को राष्ट्रपति द्वारा साहित्य, विज्ञान, कला और समाज सेवा के क्षेत्र में विशेष ज्ञान या व्यावहारिक अनुभव रखने वाले व्यक्तियों में से मनोनीत किया जाता है।
2. लोकसभा की अधिकतम संवैधानिक क्षमता 550 सदस्यों की है, जिसमें सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार के आधार पर राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों को सीटें आवंटित की जाती हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also factually correct regarding the Lok Sabha's constitutional capacity.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also factually correct regarding the Rajya Sabha's composition and nominated members.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the constitutional provisions under Articles 80 and 81 of the Constitution of India, detailing the composition, maximum strengths, and nomination criteria for the Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually accurate.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio (AIR):
1. The News Services Division operates under the motto 'Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya' and functions under the administrative oversight of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
2. The first-ever news bulletin in India was broadcast from Bombay in July 1927.
3. AIR currently broadcasts news bulletins only in the 22 languages specified in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो (AIR) के समाचार सेवा प्रभाग (NSD) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. समाचार सेवा प्रभाग 'बहुजन हिताय, बहुजन सुखाय' ध्येय वाक्य के तहत संचालित होता है और सूचना एवं प्रसारण मंत्रालय के प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण के अधीन कार्य करता है।
2. भारत में सबसे पहला समाचार बुलेटिन जुलाई 1927 में बॉम्बे से प्रसारित किया गया था।
3. AIR वर्तमान में केवल भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट 22 भाषाओं में ही समाचार बुलेटिन प्रसारित करता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statements 1 and 2 are accurate: NSD operates 24x7 under the motto 'Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya', and the historic first news broadcast in India went on air from Bombay on July 23, 1927.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually wrong; AIR broadcasts across 92 languages and dialects, including foreign languages (such as Arabic, Burmese, French, Tibetan), far exceeding the 22 scheduled languages.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 3 is incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is incorrect.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting held in New Delhi, consider the following statements:
1. The theme of India’s BRICS Chairship was designated as 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
2. During the meeting, India highlighted its achievement of reducing pollution emission intensity by over 37 percent between 2005 and 2022.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 12वें ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत की ब्रिक्स अध्यक्षता का विषय 'बिल्डिंग फॉर रेजिलिएंस, इनोवेशन, कोऑपरेशन एंड सस्टेनेबिलिटी' निर्धारित किया गया था।
2. बैठक के दौरान, भारत ने 2005 और 2022 के बीच प्रदूषण उत्सर्जन तीव्रता को 37 प्रतिशत से अधिक कम करने की अपनी उपलब्धि पर प्रकाश डाला।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct regarding India's emission intensity reduction targets.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding the theme of India's BRICS Chairship.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately capture the deliberations and official statistics presented by India at the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting hosted at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are correct.

national_questions.qe: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), frequently discussed in international trade and climate policy, is a tool introduced by which of the following?
national_questions.qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार और जलवायु नीति में बहुधा चर्चित 'कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज्म' (CBAM) निम्नलिखित में से किसके द्वारा शुरू किया गया एक उपकरण है?
oe: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)
Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
oh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु परिवर्तन फ्रेमवर्क कन्वेंशन (UNFCCC)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the WTO is a global international organization dealing with the rules of trade between nations, not the creator of CBAM.
• Option B is Correct because the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is a landmark climate policy tool instituted by the European Union to put a carbon price on imports of certain carbon-intensive goods, preventing carbon leakage and aligning external trade with the EU's emission reduction targets.
• Option C is Incorrect because the UNFCCC is an international environmental treaty addressing climate change at the UN level, distinct from unilateral trade-linked carbon border mechanisms.
• Option D is Incorrect because the OECD is an international economic organization of developed countries, not the governing authority of CBAM.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Qadian-Beas railway line infrastructure project in Punjab, consider the following statements:
1. The project involves the execution of a broad-gauge railway line in the Majha region incorporating the indigenous train collision avoidance system 'Kavach'.
2. The project is executed and overseen by the Northern Railway zone.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
पंजाब में कादियां-ब्यास रेलवे लाइन बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस परियोजना में माझा क्षेत्र में एक ब्रॉड-गेज रेलवे लाइन का निष्पादन शामिल है जिसमें स्वदेशी ट्रेन टक्कर रोधी प्रणाली 'कवच' को शामिल किया गया है।
2. इस परियोजना का निष्पादन और देखरेख उत्तर रेलवे क्षेत्र द्वारा की जाती है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct as Northern Railway executes the project.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding the broad gauge configuration and the integration of the safety system 'Kavach'.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately describe the infrastructural features, geographical location (Majha region in Punjab), technological integration (Kavach), and executing agency (Northern Railway) of the approved railway project.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are correct.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS):
1. It is procured by the Ministry of Defence through a lease agreement for enhancing the operational capabilities of the Indian Navy.
2. The primary strategic utility of these drones lies in persistent Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) and Maritime Domain Awareness over the Indian Ocean Region.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
MQ-9B सी गार्जियन हाई-एल्टीट्यूड लॉन्ग-एंड्योरेंस (HALE) रिमोटली पायलेटेड एयरक्राफ्ट सिस्टम (RPAS) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इसे भारतीय नौसेना की परिचालन क्षमताओं को बढ़ाने के लिए लीज समझौते के माध्यम से रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा प्राप्त किया गया है।
2. इन ड्रोनों का मुख्य रणनीतिक उपयोग हिंद महासागर क्षेत्र में निरंतर खुफिया जानकारी, निगरानी और टोही (ISR) तथा समुद्री क्षेत्र की जागरूकता से है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the defense acquisition contract signed between the Ministry of Defence and General Atomics for leasing two MQ-9B Sea Guardian drones to strengthen the Indian Navy's surveillance footprint in the Indian Ocean Region.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the UDISE+ (Unified District Information System for Education Plus) report, consider the following statements:
1. It is a comprehensive data collection system released to evaluate indicators in school education, tracking metrics like Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) and Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER).
2. The National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 recommended benchmark for Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) is targeted at a maximum of 50:1 across all school stages.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
UDISE+ (यिफाइड डिस्ट्रिक्ट इंफॉर्मेशन सिस्टम फॉर एजुकेशन प्लस) रिपोर्ट के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह स्कूली शिक्षा में संकेतकों का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए जारी एक व्यापक डेटा संग्रह प्रणाली है, जो छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (PTR) और सकल नामांकन अनुपात (GER) जैसे मैट्रिक्स को ट्रैक करती है।
2. राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 द्वारा छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (PTR) के लिए अनुशंसित मानक सभी स्कूली चरणों में अधिकतम 50:1 निर्धारित किया गया है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is accurate regarding the purpose and scope of the UDISE+ report in tracking education parameters, whereas statement 2 is incorrect because the NEP 2020 recommended benchmark for PTR is 30:1 (and even 25:1 in disadvantaged areas), not 50:1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 contains an incorrect benchmark figure.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 is factually flawed.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is fully accurate.

national_questions.qe: Exercise MAITREE, recently seen in news headlines, is a joint military exercise conducted between the Indian Army and the military forces of which of the following countries?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में समाचारों में देखी गई 'अभ्यास मैत्री' (Exercise MAITREE), भारतीय सेना और निम्नलिखित में से किस देश के सैन्य बलों के बीच आयोजित एक संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because joint military exercises with Malaysia are designated differently (such as Exercise Harimau Shakti).
• Option B is Correct because Exercise MAITREE is an annual bilateral military exercise conducted between the Indian Army and the Royal Thai Army, focused on enhancing interoperability in counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under UN mandates.
• Option C is Incorrect because military engagements with Vietnam include bilateral exercises like Vinbax.
• Option D is Incorrect because exercises with Indonesia are named differently (such as Exercise Garuda Shakti).

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the sixth Positive Indigenisation List (PIL) notified by the Ministry of Defence, consider the following statements:
1. It comprises a total of 405 strategically important items earmarked for indigenisation.
2. The list covers items exclusively for the Indian Army and the Indian Air Force, excluding Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs).
3. It includes Line Replaceable Units, sub-systems, and raw materials to promote self-reliance under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा अधिसूचित छठी सकारात्मक स्वदेशीकरण सूची (PIL) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इसमें स्वदेशीकरण के लिए चिन्हित कुल 405 रणनीतिक रूप से महत्वपूर्ण वस्तुएं शामिल हैं।
2. इस सूची में रक्षा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों (DPSUs) को छोड़कर विशेष रूप से भारतीय सेना और भारतीय वायु सेना के लिए वस्तुएं शामिल हैं।
3. इसमें आत्मनिर्भर भारत के तहत आत्मनिर्भता को बढ़ावा देने के लिए लाइन रिप्लेसेबल यूनिट्स, उप-प्रणालियां और कच्चे माल शामिल हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the sixth Positive Indigenisation List notified by the Ministry of Defence comprises 405 items, which includes 16 items for the Indian Coast Guard and 389 items for Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs), making statement 1 correct. Statement 3 is also correct as these lists include Line Replaceable Units, sub-systems, sub-assemblies, spares, and raw materials to boost domestic manufacturing under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually wrong; the items are designated for DPSUs and the Indian Coast Guard, not exclusively for the Army and Air Force.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is also correct along with statement 1.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the SEMICON India 2026 conference:
1. The 5th edition of SEMICON India 2026 is scheduled to be held in New Delhi.
2. The core theme for this edition of the conference is 'Silicon to Systems, Building the Ecosystems'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
सेमिकॉन इंडिया 2026 सम्मेलन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. सेमिकॉन इंडिया 2026 का 5वां संस्करण नई दिल्ली में आयोजित होने के लिए निर्धारित है।
2. सम्मेलन के इस संस्करण का मुख्य विषय 'सिलिकॉन टू सिस्टम्स, बिल्डिंग द इकोसिस्टम्स' है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because both statements are factually correct. The 5th edition of SEMICON India 2026 is hosted in New Delhi, highlighting India's expanding footprint in semiconductor manufacturing and design, and the theme is indeed 'Silicon to Systems, Building the Ecosystems' with participation from global exhibitors across multiple countries.
• Option A is Incorrect because both statements are correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.

national_questions.qe:
With respect to the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) and its interface with India's trade policies, consider the following statements:
1. CBAM is designed to put a carbon price on imports of a targeted set of products to prevent 'carbon leakage'.
2. Differences in carbon cost measurement and recognition between Indian domestic frameworks and the EU's CBAM risk imposing a double compliance burden on Indian exporters.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
यूरोपीय संघ के कार्बन सीमा समायोजन तंत्र (CBAM) और भारत की व्यापार नीतियों के साथ इसके अंतर्संबंध के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. CBAM को 'कार्बन लीकेज' को रोकने के लिए लक्षित उत्पादों के आयात पर कार्बन मूल्य लगाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।
2. भारतीय घरेलू ढाँचों और यूरोपीय संघ के CBAM के बीच कार्बन लागत माप और मान्यता में अंतर से भारतीय निर्यातकों पर दोहरे अनुपालन का बोझ पड़ने का जोखिम है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the structural implications of CBAM. Statement 1 describes the core objective of CBAM, which is to levy carbon tariffs on carbon-intensive imports (like steel, cement, aluminum) to equalize the carbon price between domestic EU production and imports, thereby stopping carbon leakage. Statement 2 is also correct as divergent methodologies for carbon accounting between India and the EU create compliance friction and potential double taxation for Indian goods.
• Option A is Incorrect as statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect as statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Incorrect as both statements are factually and conceptually correct.

national_questions.qe: In the context of the recent multi-state crackdown by Indian security agencies against the Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN), the network is primarily backed by intelligence apparatus originating from which country?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय सुरक्षा एजेंसियों द्वारा शाहजहाँ भट्टी नेटवर्क (SBN) के खिलाफ हाल ही में चलाए गए बहु-राज्यीय अभियान के संदर्भ में, यह नेटवर्क मुख्य रूप से किस देश के खुफिया तंत्र द्वारा समर्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN) is a Pakistan-based, ISI-backed network against which coordinated counter-terrorism crackdowns involving multiple states and stringent statutes like the UAPA, BNS, and Arms Act have been executed by Indian security agencies.
• Option A is Incorrect because the SBN is not backed by Afghan intelligence entities.
• Option C is Incorrect because Myanmar does not serve as the origin of this specific terror network.
• Option D is Incorrect because the network has linkages with Pakistan's ISI rather than Chinese intelligence bodies in this operational context.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the recent contract signed by the Ministry of Defence for leasing MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) RPAS, consider the following statements:
1. The drones are procured for the Indian Navy to enhance its Maritime Domain Awareness.
2. The contract is executed with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
रक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा MQ-9B सी गार्जियन हाई-एल्टीट्यूड लॉन्ग-एंड्योरेंस (HALE) RPAS को पट्टे पर लेने के लिए हस्ताक्षरित हालिया अनुबंध के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इन ड्रोनों को भारतीय नौसेना के लिए उसकी समुद्री क्षेत्र की जागरूकता (Maritime Domain Awareness) को बढ़ाने के लिए अधिगृहीत किया गया है।
2. यह अनुबंध जनरल एटॉमिक्स एयरोनॉटिकल सिस्टम्स, इंक. (GA-ASI) के साथ निष्पादित किया गया है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because both statements are accurate. The Ministry of Defence contracted General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) to lease two MQ-9B Sea Guardian HALE Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS) for the Indian Navy, aiming to bolster surveillance, reconnaissance, and persistent tracking capabilities across the Indian Ocean Region.
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Incorrect because both statements are correct.

national_questions.qe: The joint military exercise 'MAITREE-XV' is conducted annually/regularly between the Indian Army and the military forces of which country?
national_questions.qh: संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास 'मैत्री-XV' भारतीय सेना और किस देश के सैन्य बलों के बीच आयोजित किया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Exercise MAITREE is a bilateral joint military training event conducted between the Indian Army and the Royal Thai Army, focusing on counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism operations under UN mandate.
• Option A is Incorrect as joint exercises with Vietnam are named Vinbax.
• Option C is Incorrect as joint exercises with Indonesia include Garuda Shakti.
• Option D is Incorrect as joint exercises with Malaysia include Harimau Shakti.

national_questions.qe: The long-standing reciprocal tradition between India and Nepal of conferring the honorary rank of General of each other's Army to their respective Army Chiefs was initiated in which year?
national_questions.qh: भारत और नेपाल के बीच एक-दूसरे के सेना प्रमुखों को अपनी-अपनी सेना के जनरल की मानद उपाधि से सम्मानित करने की दीर्घकालिक पारस्परिक परंपरा किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the historical diplomatic and military tradition of conferring the honorary rank of General of the Nepali Army to the Indian Army Chief (and vice versa) was instituted in 1950, symbolizing deep-rooted bilateral defence ties and mutual trust.
• Option A is Incorrect as 1947 marks India's independence rather than the start of this specific bilateral military tradition.
• Option C is Incorrect as 1962 relates to the Sino-Indian war, unrelated to the origin of this exchange.
• Option D is Incorrect as 1971 marks the Bangladesh Liberation War.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the recently approved Qadian-Beas railway line project, consider the following statements:
1. The project is located in the Majha region of Punjab and will be executed by Northern Railway.
2. The rail corridor incorporates the deployment of 'Kavach', India's indigenous automatic train protection system.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
हाल ही में स्वीकृत कादियान-ब्यास रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह परियोजना पंजाब के माझा क्षेत्र में स्थित है और इसे उत्तर रेलवे (Northern Railway) द्वारा निष्पादित किया जाएगा।
2. इस रेल गलियारे में भारत की स्वदेशी ट्रेन सुरक्षा प्रणाली 'कवच' (Kavach) को शामिल किया गया है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because both statements are accurate. The Qadian-Beas broad gauge railway line project in Punjab's Majha region has been approved with execution entrusted to Northern Railway to improve regional connectivity and serve as an alternative strategic route. Furthermore, modern safety infrastructure including 'Kavach'—India's indigenous Train Collision Avoidance System—is mandated for deployment along this corridor.
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Incorrect because both statements are correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to areca nut (betel nut) production in India as per the Directorate of Arecanut and Spices Development (DASD) for 2025-26, consider the following statements:
1. India is the world's largest producer of areca nut, contributing approximately 63% of the total global production.
2. Karnataka is the largest producing state in India, followed by Kerala, Assam, and Meghalaya.
3. The total cultivation area has crossed 15 lakh hectares across the country.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
अरेका नट (सुपारी) उत्पादन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत विश्व का सबसे बड़ा अरेका नट उत्पादक है, जो कुल वैश्विक उत्पादन का लगभग 63% योगदान देता है।
2. कर्नाटक भारत का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक राज्य है, इसके बाद केरल, असम और मेघालय का स्थान है।
3. देश भर में कुल खेती का क्षेत्र 15 लाख हेक्टेयर को पार कर गया है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (India accounts for ~63% of global areca nut production making it the largest producer) and statement 2 is correct (Karnataka leads production with ~10 lakh tonnes, followed by Kerala, Assam, Meghalaya, etc.). Statement 3 is incorrect because the total cultivation area is 11.06 lakh hectares, not 15 lakh hectares (production is 15.29 lakh tonnes).
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually incorrect regarding the cultivation area.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is completely omitted despite being correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 overestimates the cultivation area which is actually 11.06 lakh hectares.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following regarding the PSB Confluence 2026 and Public Sector Banks (PSBs) in India:
1. The confluence was organized by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
2. Discussions centered on themes including Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, and Investment Cycles.
3. Public Sector Banks are currently grappling with historically high Non-Performing Assets (NPAs), necessitating immediate bailout packages.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
PSB संगम 2026 और भारत में सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों (PSB) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस संगम का आयोजन वित्त मंत्रालय के वित्तीय सेवा विभाग (DFS) द्वारा किया गया था।
2. चर्चाएँ जमा जुटाव, युवाओं के लिए बैंकिंग और निवेश चक्र सहित विषयों पर केंद्रित थीं।
3. सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंक वर्तमान में ऐतिहासिक रूप से उच्च गैर-निष्पादित परिसंपत्तियों (NPA) से जूझ रहे हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct along with statement 1.
• Option B is Correct because statement 1 is correct (organized by Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance) and statement 2 is correct (focused on themes like Deposit Mobilisation, Banking for Youth, Investment Cycles). Statement 3 is factually incorrect because PSBs currently exhibit *historically low* Non-Performing Assets (NPAs), providing a strong foundation for reforms.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 3 is wrong as NPAs are at historically low levels, not high.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 contains a direct factual error.

national_questions.qe:
In the context of recent multi-state security operations against the Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN), consider the following statements:
1. The network has been identified as having active backing from external intelligence agencies like the ISI.
2. Legal actions against members of the syndicate include invoking the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), and the Arms Act.
3. Recoveries made from the syndicate exclusively comprised digital espionage tools, with no conventional explosives or ordinance-marked arms detected.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
शाहिद भट्टी नेटवर्क (SBN) के खिलाफ हालिया बहु-राज्य सुरक्षा अभियानों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस नेटवर्क की पहचान ISI जैसी बाहरी खुफिया एजेंसियों के सक्रिय समर्थन के रूप में की गई है।
2. सिंडिकेट के सदस्यों के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई में गैरकानूनी गतिविधियां (रोकथाम) अधिनियम (UAPA), भारतीय न्याय संहिता (BNS) और शस्त्र अधिनियम को शामिल किया गया है।
3. सिंडिकेट से बरामदगी में विशेष रूप से डिजिटल जासूसी उपकरण शामिल थे।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (ISI-backed network) and statement 2 is correct (provisions of UAPA, BNS, and Arms Act invoked after arrests and FIRs). Statement 3 is incorrect because recoveries included physical military-grade weapons like IEDs and Pakistan Ordnance Factory-marked grenades, not *exclusively* digital tools.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually false as lethal conventional weapons and IEDs were seized.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is correct and statement 3 is incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 contradicts official recovery reports of IEDs and ordnance.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the UDISE+ 2025-26 report released by the Ministry of Education, consider the following statements:
1. The overall Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) reported at the national level is well within the benchmark recommended by the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.
2. The Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) at the Secondary stage is higher than the GER recorded at the Middle stage.
3. The report covers infrastructure and enrollment parameters across more than 14 lakh schools nationwide.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी UDISE+ 2025-26 रिपोर्ट के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर दर्ज कुल छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात (PTR) राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 द्वारा अनुशंसित बेंचमार्क के भीतर है।
2. माध्यमिक स्तर पर सकल नामांकन अनुपात (GER) मध्य स्तर पर दर्ज GER से अधिक है।
3. यह रिपोर्ट देश भर के 14 लाख से अधिक स्कूलों में बुनियादी ढांचा और नामांकन मापदंडों को कवर करती है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also correct and statement 2 is incorrect.
• Option B is Correct because statement 1 is correct (PTR is 24:1 against NEP recommendation of 30:1) and statement 3 is correct (covers 14.67 lakh schools). Statement 2 is incorrect because Secondary stage GER (71.7%) is lower than Middle stage GER (89.6%).
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 states Secondary GER is higher than Middle GER, which is false.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the challenges posed by the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) alongside trade agreements like the India-EU FTA:
1. CBAM acts as a carbon tariff on carbon-intensive products entering the EU, aligning import prices with internal EU carbon pricing.
2. Discrepancies in carbon measurement frameworks between domestic Indian laws and EU standards create potential compliance and reporting burdens for Indian exporters.
3. The financial phase of CBAM was deferred indefinitely pending the full ratification of bilateral free trade agreements.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत-जैसे व्यापार समझौतों के साथ यूरोपीय संघ के कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज्म (CBAM) द्वारा प्रस्तुत चुनौतियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. CBAM यूरोपीय संघ में प्रवेश करने वाले कार्बन-सघन उत्पादों पर एक कार्बन टैरिफ के रूप में कार्य करता है।
2. घरेलू भारतीय कानूनों और यूरोपीय संघ के मानकों के बीच कार्बन माप ढांचे में विसंगतियाँ भारतीय निर्यातकों के लिए अनुपालन बोझ पैदा करती हैं।
3. द्विपक्षीय मुक्त व्यापार समझौतों के पूर्ण अनुसमर्थन तक CBAM के वित्तीय चरण को अनिश्चित काल के लिए टाल दिया गया था।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 accurately defines CBAM's core objective of pricing carbon on imports into the EU, and statement 2 correctly identifies the compliance challenge of mismatched carbon measurement and reporting standards between India and the EU. Statement 3 is incorrect because the definitive financial phase of CBAM entered into force concurrently without being deferred for FTAs.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually incorrect.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is omitted despite being valid.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is wrong.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the newly approved Qadian-Beas railway line project in Punjab, consider the following statements:
1. The project aims to improve regional connectivity in Punjab's Majha region under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme.
2. The rail alignment incorporates 'Kavach', India's indigenous automatic train collision avoidance system.
3. The project is being executed exclusively by private sector consortiums under a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model without central exchequer funding.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
पंजाब में नवनिर्वीकृत कादियन-ब्यास रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस परियोजना का उद्देश्य सामाजिक रूप से वांछनीय रेल कनेक्टिविटी कार्यक्रम के तहत पंजाब के माझा क्षेत्र में क्षेत्रीय कनेक्टिविटी में सुधार करना है।
2. रेल संरेखण में भारत की स्वदेशी ट्रेन टक्कर से बचने की प्रणाली 'कवच' शामिल है।
3. इस परियोजना को पूरी तरह से निजी क्षेत्र के संघों द्वारा वित्तपोषित और निष्पादित किया जा रहा है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (executed by Northern Railway under Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme in Majha region) and statement 2 is correct (incorporates indigenous 'Kavach' safety technology). Statement 3 is incorrect because the project is centrally approved with direct capital outlays (Rs 1,419.05 crore) executed by Northern Railway, not by private BOT without central funding.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is false.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is omitted despite being correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually incorrect.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the historical background and operational framework of the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio:
1. The motto of the News Services Division is 'Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya'.
2. India's first news bulletin was broadcasted in the year 1927 from the Bombay Station under the Indian Broadcasting Company.
3. NSD exclusively broadcasts bulletins in English and Hindi, restricting regional and foreign language transmissions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो के समाचार सेवा प्रभाग (NSD) की ऐतिहासिक पृष्ठभूमि और परिचालन ढाँचे के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. समाचार सेवा प्रभाग का आदर्श वाक्य 'बहुजन हिताय, बहुजन सुखाय' है।
2. भारत का पहला समाचार बुलेटिन वर्ष 1927 में इंडियन ब्रॉडकास्टिंग कंपनी के तहत बॉम्बे स्टेशन से प्रसारित किया गया था।
3. NSD विशेष रूप से अंग्रेजी और हिंदी में बुलेटिन प्रसारित करता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (operates under 'Bahujan Hitaya, Bahujan Sukhaya') and statement 2 is correct (first bulletin broadcasted on July 23, 1927 from Bombay Station). Statement 3 is incorrect because NSD broadcasts in 92 languages/dialects, including regional languages and foreign languages like Arabic, French, and Chinese, not just English and Hindi.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is false and statement 1 is correct.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is correct but statement 3 is false.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is entirely incorrect.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the All India Radio Broadcasting Code and Election Coverage Guidelines, consider the following statements:
1. The AIR Broadcasting Code strictly prohibits criticism of friendly countries, attacks on religions, and contempt of court.
2. The code permits direct hostile personal tirades against Central and State government policies as part of uninhibited political debate.
3. The Election Commission mandates that electronic media must avoid projecting only a single candidate per constituency to ensure balanced coverage.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो प्रसारण संहिता और चुनाव कवरेज दिशानिर्देशों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. AIR प्रसारण संहिता मित्र देशों की आलोचना, धर्मों पर हमले और अदालत की अवमानना को सख्ती से प्रतिबंधित करती है।
2. यह संहिता केंद्रीय और राज्य सरकार की नीतियों के खिलाफ प्रत्यक्ष शत्रुतापूर्ण व्यक्तिगत तिरस्कार की अनुमति देती है।
3. चुनाव आयोग यह अनिवार्य करता है कि इलेक्ट्रॉनिक मीडिया को संतुलित कवरेज सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्रति निर्वाचन क्षेत्र केवल एक उम्मीदवार को प्रोजेक्ट करने से बचना चाहिए।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (AIR Broadcasting Code bans friendly-country criticism, religious attacks, and contempt of court) and statement 3 is correct (EC guidelines bar projection of single candidates and mandate balanced coverage). Statement 2 is incorrect because the code explicitly bars personal tirades and hostile criticism of government policies that cross into personal attacks.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually false regarding personal tirades.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is incorrect.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the agricultural and climate trade challenges facing India in 2026:
1. India achieved the world's highest areca nut production share in 2025-26 under the oversight of DASD.
2. The European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive financial phase, posing potential double compliance burdens for Indian exporters alongside the newly concluded India-EU FTA.
3. Areca nut cultivation in India is exclusively restricted to the Indo-Gangetic plains with zero presence in southern states.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
2026 में भारत के सामने आने वाली कृषि और जलवायु व्यापार चुनौतियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत ने DASD की देखरेख में 2025-26 में दुनिया का सबसे अधिक सुपारी उत्पादन हिस्सा हासिल किया।
2. यूरोपीय संघ का कार्बन बॉर्डर एडजस्टमेंट मैकेनिज्म (CBAM) अपने निश्चित वित्तीय चरण में प्रवेश कर गया है।
3. भारत में सुपारी की खेती विशेष रूप से दक्षिणी राज्यों में किसी भी उपस्थिति के बिना भारत-गंगा के मैदानों तक सीमित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (India leads with 63% share via DASD data) and statement 2 is correct (CBAM financial phase implementation coincides with India-EU FTA creating compliance overlap). Statement 3 is incorrect because areca nut is predominantly grown in southern and coastal states like Karnataka and Kerala, not restricted to the Indo-Gangetic plains.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is wrong.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is omitted despite being valid.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is false.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to educational benchmarks and banking reforms discussed in policy reports of 2025-26, consider the following statements:
1. The UDISE+ 2025-26 report indicates that the national Pupil-Teacher Ratio complies with NEP 2020 benchmarks.
2. The Department of Financial Services announced plans to establish a High-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat.
3. Public Sector Banks recorded surging NPA ratios that threaten the stability of the Indian banking sector.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
2025-26 की नीतिगत रिपोर्टों में चर्चा किए गए शैक्षणिक और बैंकिंग सुधारों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. UDISE+ 2025-26 रिपोर्ट इंगित करती है कि राष्ट्रीय छात्र-शिक्षक अनुपात NEP 2020 के मानदंडों का पालन करता है।
2. वित्तीय सेवा विभाग ने विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग सुधारों पर एक उच्च-धिकार प्राप्त समिति की स्थापना करने की योजना की घोषणा की।
3. सार्वजनिक सेक्टर के बैंकों ने बढ़ते NPA अनुपात दर्ज किए हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (PTR is 24:1 against NEP's 30:1 limit) and statement 2 is correct (High-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat announced at PSB Confluence). Statement 3 is incorrect because NPAs are historically low, not surging.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually incorrect.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 1 is omitted despite being correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 contradicts banking health data.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding infrastructure and internal security measures initiated in India:
1. The Qadian-Beas railway line project in Punjab features the integration of India's indigenous 'Kavach' anti-collision system.
2. Security agencies carried out multi-state crackdowns targeting networks like the Shahzad Bhatti Network under provisions of the UAPA.
3. The Qadian-Beas rail project excludes the construction of any Road Under Bridges (RUBs) or minor bridges.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में शुरू किए गए बुनियादी ढांचे और आंतरिक सुरक्षा उपायों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. पंजाब में कादियन-ब्यास रेलवे लाइन परियोजना में भारत की स्वदेशी 'कवच' एंटी-कोलिजन प्रणाली का एकीकरण शामिल है।
2. सुरक्षा एजेंसियों ने UAPA के प्रावधानों के तहत शाहबाज भट्टी नेटवर्क जैसे नेटवर्क को लक्षित करते हुए बहु-राज्य कार्रवाई की।
3. कादियन-ब्यास रेल परियोजना में किसी भी सड़क के नीचे पुलों (RUBs) का निर्माण शामिल नहीं है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (Kavach system incorporated) and statement 2 is correct (SBN crackdown involved UAPA, BNS, Arms Act). Statement 3 is incorrect because the project includes 54 Road Under Bridges (RUBs), 11 major bridges, and 121 minor bridges.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 3 is factually false.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is omitted despite being correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 3 is wrong.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to public broadcasting and media governance in India, consider the following statements:
1. The News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio traces its earliest news broadcasting roots back to 1927 in Bombay.
2. The All India Radio Broadcasting Code allows unrestricted criticism and personal aspersions against the personal integrity of the President and Governors.
3. NSD broadcasts daily bulletins across dozens of regional and international languages.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में सार्वजनिक प्रसारण और मीडिया शासन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. ऑल इंडिया रेडियो के समाचार सेवा प्रभाग (NSD) की सबसे पुरानी समाचार प्रसारण जड़ें 1927 में बॉम्बे में हैं।
2. ऑल इंडिया रेडियो प्रसारण संहिता राष्ट्रपति और राज्यपालों की व्यक्तिगत अखंडता के खिलाफ अप्रतिबंधित आलोचना और व्यक्तिगत आक्षेप की अनुमति देती है।
3. NSD दर्जनों क्षेत्रीय और अंतरराष्ट्रीय भाषाओं में दैनिक बुलेटिन प्रसारित करता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct (first bulletin broadcasted in July 1927 from Bombay Station) and statement 3 is correct (NSD broadcasts 607 daily bulletins across 92 languages/dialects). Statement 2 is incorrect because the AIR Broadcasting Code explicitly bars aspersions against the integrity of the President, Governors, and the Judiciary.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is false.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 violates the AIR code provisions.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the recently approved Qadian-Beas railway line project in Punjab, consider the following statements:
1. The project is revived under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme.
2. It exclusively connects districts located entirely within the Malwa region of Punjab.
3. The corridor incorporates indigenous 'Kavach' anti-collision technology.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
हाल ही में पंजाब में स्वीकृत कादियां-ब्यास रेलवे लाइन परियोजना के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस परियोजना को सामाजिक रूप से वांछनीय रेल कनेक्टिविटी कार्यक्रम के तहत पुनर्जीवित किया गया है।
2. यह विशेष रूप से पंजाब के मालवा क्षेत्र के भीतर पूरी तरह से स्थित जिलों को जोड़ती है।
3. इस गलियारे में स्वदेशी 'कवच' एंटी-कोलिजन तकनीक को शामिल किया गया है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is wrong; the project connects Qadian in Gurdaspur district with Beas in Amritsar district, which are situated in Punjab's Majha region, not the Malwa region.
• Option B is Correct because statement 1 is right as the 39.68 km broad gauge line was approved under the Socially Desirable Rail Connectivity Programme, and statement 3 is right as the infrastructure features indigenous Kavach anti-collision technology along with 11 major bridges and 54 RUBs.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually incorrect regarding the geographic region (Majha vs Malwa).
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is false.

national_questions.qe: According to the Directorate of Arecanut and Spices Development (DASD) data for 2025-26, India stands as the world's largest producer of Areca Nut. In this context, which state contributes the highest production of areca nut in India?
national_questions.qh: अरेकनट एंड स्पाइस डेवलपमेंट निदेशालय (DASD) के 2025-26 के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, भारत सुपारी (Areca Nut) का दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है। इस संदर्भ में, भारत में सुपारी का सबसे अधिक उत्पादन कौन सा राज्य करता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Kerala is a major producer but ranks second after Karnataka in overall production.
• Option B is Incorrect because Assam follows Kerala and contributes significantly to the northeastern share, but is not the top producer.
• Option C is Correct because Karnataka is the leading producer of areca nut in India, contributing around 10 lakh tonnes out of the total national production, under the overall global share where India accounts for about 63%.
• Option D is Incorrect because Meghalaya has minor production compared to southern and northeastern leaders.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following initiatives and bodies discussed during the PSB Confluence 2026 hosted by the Department of Financial Services (DFS):
1. Formation of a High-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat.
2. Strategic focus on Deposit Mobilisation and Global Capability Centres (GCCs).
3. Targeting the banking needs of the youth demographic aged 15-29 years.
Which of the above were key focal points of the confluence?
national_questions.qh:
वित्तीय सेवा विभाग (DFS) द्वारा आयोजित पीएसबी कॉन्फ्लुएंस 2026 के दौरान चर्चा किए गए निम्नलिखित पहलों और निकायों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. 'विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग सुधारों पर उच्च-स्तरीय समिति' का गठन।
2. जमा जुटाने (Deposit Mobilisation) और वैश्विक क्षमता केंद्रों (GCCs) पर रणनीतिक फोकस।
3. 15-29 आयु वर्ग की युवा जनसांख्यिकी की बैंकिंग आवश्यकताओं को लक्षित करना।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन से कॉन्फ्लुएंस के मुख्य केंद्र बिंदु थे?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also correct; youth banking for the 15-29 demographic was a core theme.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding the announcement of the High-powered Committee on Banking Reforms for Viksit Bharat.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct regarding Deposit Mobilisation and GCCs.
• Option D is Correct because all three statements accurately reflect the strategic themes and announcements made during the PSB Confluence 2026 hosted by the Ministry of Finance's DFS.

national_questions.qe: The Ministry of Defence recently signed a contract to lease two MQ-9B Sea Guardian High-Altitude Long-Endurance (HALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems. These systems are procured from which of the following countries/defense firms?
national_questions.qh: रक्षा मंत्रालय ने हाल ही में दो MQ-9B सी गार्डियन हाई-एल्टीट्यूड लॉन्ग-एंड्योरेंस (HALE) रिमोटली पायलेटेड एयरक्राफ्ट सिस्टम को पट्टे (Lease) पर लेने के लिए एक अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं। ये सिस्टम निम्नलिखित में से किस देश/रक्षा फर्म से प्राप्त किए गए हैं?
oe: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI), United States
oh: जनरल एटॉमिक्स एयरोनॉटिकल सिस्टम्स, इंक. (GA-ASI), संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because IAI is an Israeli defense contractor associated with Heron drones, not the MQ-9B Sea Guardian.
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry of Defence signed the Rs 1,943 crore lease agreement with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) of the United States to empower the Indian Navy with enhanced Maritime Domain Awareness.
• Option C is Incorrect because Thales is a French multinational operating in aerospace and defense electronics, not the maker of MQ-9B.
• Option D is Incorrect because Rosoboronexport is a Russian state-owned arms exporter.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) operations and the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement in context with areca nut smuggling:
1. Areca nut imports into India normally attract a high Basic Customs Duty (BCD).
2. Concessional or zero-duty benefits under SAFTA were fraudulently claimed by mis-declaring Indonesian and Thai areca nuts as originating from Bangladesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
अरेकनट तस्करी के संदर्भ में राजस्व खुफिया निदेशालय (DRI) के संचालन और दक्षिण एशिया मुक्त व्यापार क्षेत्र (SAFTA) समझौते के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत में सुपारी के आयात पर सामान्यतः उच्च मूल सीमा शुल्क (BCD) लगता है।
2. इंडोनेशियाई और थाई सुपारी को बांग्लादेश से उत्पन्न होने वाले के रूप में गलत तरीके से घोषित करके SAFTA के तहत रियायती या शून्य-शुल्क लाभ का fraudulently दावा किया गया था।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct; syndicates mis-declared South-East Asian areca nuts as Bangladeshi origin to exploit SAFTA.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct; standard areca nut imports attract a high Basic Customs Duty of 100%.
• Option C is Correct because both statements are factually accurate. DRI uncovered a massive duty evasion scam where areca nuts from Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia were smuggled via fake Bangladeshi certificates under SAFTA to bypass the 100% BCD.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements correctly reflect the modus operandi uncovered by DRI.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the National Anubhav Awards, consider the following statements:
1. The 'Anubhav' platform is designed for retiring and retired central government, public sector bank, and PSU employees to share their working experiences.
2. The awards are conferred by the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
राष्ट्रीय अनुभव पुरस्कार (National Anubhav Awards) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. 'अनुभव' मंच सेवानिवृत्त हो रहे और सेवानिवृत्त केंद्रीय सरकार, सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंक और सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों (PSU) के कर्मचारियों के लिए अपने कार्य अनुभवों को साझा करने हेतु डिजाइन किया गया है।
2. ये पुरस्कार कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय द्वारा प्रदान किए जाते हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct; the awards are administered by the Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare under the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions (headed by MoS Dr Jitendra Singh).
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct; Anubhav enables retiring personnel from central departments, PSBs, and PSUs to document administrative reforms and governance contributions.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately describe the mandate, eligibility, and administrative control of the National Anubhav Awards platform.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually sound.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Census 2027 exercise in India, consider the following statements regarding Ladakh:
1. Ladakh has become the first Union Territory in India to commence the Census 2027 exercise, initiating digital self-enumeration.
2. The population enumeration phase is scheduled ahead of the standard timeline with October 1 as the reference date to accommodate harsh winter weather conditions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में जनगणना 2027 अभ्यास के संदर्भ में, लद्दाख के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. लद्दाख डिजिटल स्व-गणना शुरू करते हुए जनगणना 2027 अभ्यास शुरू करने वाला भारत का पहला केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बन गया है।
2. कठोर सर्दियों की मौसम स्थितियों को समायोजित करने के लिए 1 अक्टूबर को संदर्भ तिथि के रूप में निर्धारित करते हुए जनसंख्या गणना चरण मानक समय सीमा से पहले निर्धारित किया गया है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct along with statement 1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct along with statement 2.
• Option C is Correct because Ladakh has indeed become the first Union Territory to commence the Census 2027 exercise through digital self-enumeration (August 17-31), and the population enumeration phase is planned from September 1 to 30 with October 1 as the reference date specifically to counter harsh winter conditions in the high-altitude terrain.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately reflect the official administrative scheduling and geographical adaptations of the Census 2027 in Ladakh.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition:
1. Amrit Udyan is located within the Rashtrapati Bhavan complex and opens periodically for public viewings including the Summer Annuals edition.
2. On-the-spot physical ticket bookings are mandatory for entry as online advance bookings are not permitted for visitors.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
अमृत उद्यान ग्रीष्मकालीन वार्षिक संस्करण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. अमृत उद्यान राष्ट्रपति भवन परिसर के भीतर स्थित है और ग्रीष्मकालीन वार्षिक संस्करण सहित सार्वजनिक दर्शन के लिए समय-समय पर खुलता है।
2. आगंतुकों के लिए ऑनलाइन अग्रिम बुकिंग की अनुमति नहीं होने के कारण प्रवेश के लिए ऑन-द-स्पॉट भौतिक टिकट बुकिंग अनिवार्य है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct as Amrit Udyan at Rashtrapati Bhavan opens for public viewing during specific editions like the Summer Annuals. Statement 2 is incorrect because online advance booking via the official Rashtrapati Bhavan portal is required, and on-the-spot bookings are explicitly not available.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually false regarding on-the-spot ticket bookings.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is invalid.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) and international trade agreements, consider the following statements:
1. The DRI operates under the aegis of the Ministry of Finance to curb customs duty evasion, smuggling, and commercial frauds.
2. Under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement, member nations can claim customs duty exemptions provided goods meet the specified Rules of Origin criteria.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
राजस्व खुफिया निदेशालय (DRI) और अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार समझौतों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. DRI सीमा शुल्क की चोरी, तस्करी और वाणिज्यिक धोखाधड़ी को रोकने के लिए वित्त मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में कार्य करता है।
2. दक्षिण एशियाई मुक्त व्यापार क्षेत्र (SAFTA) समझौते के तहत, सदस्य देश सीमा शुल्क छूट का दावा कर सकते हैं बशर्ते वस्तुएं निर्धारित उत्पत्ति के नियम (Rules of Origin) मानदंडों को पूरा करती हों।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Correct because the DRI functions under the Ministry of Finance and recently uncovered massive duty evasion where areca nuts from Southeast Asia were fraudulently routed through Bangladesh to wrongfully claim 100% duty exemption under SAFTA Rules of Origin, causing huge revenue losses.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately describe the institutional mandate of DRI and trade agreement provisions.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Anubhav' platform and National Anubhav Awards:
1. The Anubhav platform allows retiring and retired employees of the Central Government, Public Sector Banks, and CPSEs to share their working experiences and contribute to administrative documentation.
2. The awards and associated guidelines promote digital governance initiatives such as the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
'अनुभव' मंच और राष्ट्रीय अनुभव पुरस्कारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. अनुभव मंच केंद्र सरकार, सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों और CPSE के सेवानिवृत्त और सेवानिवृत्त हो रहे कर्मचारियों को अपने कार्य अनुभवों को साझा करने और प्रशासनिक प्रलेखन में योगदान करने की अनुमति देता है।
2. पुरस्कार और संबंधित दिशा-निर्देश राष्ट्रव्यापी डिजिटल जीवन प्रमाण पत्र (DLC) अभियान जैसी डिजिटल शासन पहलों को बढ़ावा देते हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct alongside statement 1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Correct because the Department of Pension & Pensioners' Welfare administers the Anubhav awards and portal, enabling retiring/retired personnel from Central Govt, CPSEs, and PSBs to record their governance contributions, alongside launching welfare tools like Pension Mitra and the nationwide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately describe the core objectives of the Anubhav scheme.

national_questions.qe: In the context of weather forecasting nomenclature used by the India Meteorological Department (IMD), what does a 'Red Alert' warning signify?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली मौसम पूर्वानुमान नामकरण के संदर्भ में, 'रेड अलर्ट' चेतावनी का क्या तात्पर्य है?
oe: Be updated and monitor local weather conditions for minor variations
Be prepared to take protective action due to potential infrastructure damage
Take immediate action as extremely severe weather conditions are expected to cause major disruptions
No advisory required as the severe weather system has dissipated
oh: मामूली बदलावों के लिए अपडेट रहें और स्थानीय मौसम की स्थिति की निगरानी करें
संभावित बुनियादी ढांचे के नुकसान के कारण सुरक्षात्मक कार्रवाई करने के लिए तैयार रहें
तत्काल कार्रवाई करें क्योंकि अत्यधिक गंभीर मौसम स्थिति के कारण बड़ी बाधाएं आने की उम्मीद है
कोई सलाह आवश्यक नहीं है क्योंकि गंभीर मौसम प्रणाली समाप्त हो गई है
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as it describes a Green or lower-level advisory.
• Option B is Incorrect as it corresponds to an Orange or Yellow warning stage signifying preparedness.
• Option C is Correct because an IMD 'Red Alert' is the highest level of weather warning, issued to advise authorities and citizens to take immediate, urgent action to protect lives and property against extremely heavy rainfall or severe cyclonic storms that pose severe risks.
• Option D is Incorrect as a Red Alert indicates heightened danger, not dissipation.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Esports World Cup Chess Title: 
1. World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen won the tournament for the second consecutive year, defeating Denis Lazavik in the final.
2. The tournament was hosted in Geneva, Switzerland, with American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura finishing third.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ईस्पोर्ट्स वर्ल्ड कप चेस टाइटल के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. विश्व नंबर-1 मैग्नस कार्लसन ने फाइनल में डेनिस लाज़ाविक को हराकर लगातार दूसरे वर्ष यह टूर्नामेंट जीता।
2. इस टूर्नामेंट की मेजबानी जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड द्वारा की गई थी, जिसमें अमेरिकी ग्रैंडमास्टर हिकारू नाकामुरा तीसरे स्थान पर रहे।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup chess title for the second consecutive year by defeating Belarusian Grandmaster Denis Lazavik 2-0 in the finals held in Paris, France (not Geneva), while American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured the third position.
• Option B is Incorrect because the tournament took place in Paris, France, not Geneva, Switzerland.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 contains geographical inaccuracies regarding the host city.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is factually accurate.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the National Anubhav Awards 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The awards are conferred to recognize the contributions of retiring Central Government, Public Sector Bank (PSB), and CPSE employees to governance reforms.
2. The 'Anubhav' platform is managed under the administrative purview of the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
राष्ट्रीय अनुभव पुरस्कार 2026 के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. ये पुरस्कार केंद्र सरकार, सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंकों (PSB) और CPSE के सेवानिवृत्त कर्मचारियों के शासन सुधारों में योगदान को मान्यता देने के लिए प्रदान किए जाते हैं।
2. 'अनुभव' प्लेटफॉर्म कार्मिक, लोक शिकायत और पेंशन मंत्रालय के प्रशासनिक दायरे में प्रबंधित किया जाता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect by omission because statement 2 is also correct; the platform is indeed administered under the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.
• Option B is Incorrect by omission because statement 1 correctly describes the eligibility and objective of the National Anubhav Awards.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately describe the National Anubhav Awards 2026, the eligibility of retiring Central Government, PSB, and CPSE employees, and the administrative ministry handling the 'Anubhav' portal.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually correct.

national_questions.qe:
Regarding the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting hosted by India, consider the following statements:
1. The meeting was held under India's 2026 BRICS Chairship theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
2. Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation & Forest Fire Management, Circular Economy, and Climate Adaptation were identified as key priority areas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत द्वारा आयोजित 12वें ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह बैठक भारत की 2026 की ब्रिक्स अध्यक्षता के तहत 'बिल्डिंग फॉर रेजिलिएंस, इनोवेशन, कोऑपरेशन एंडSustainability' विषय के अंतर्गत आयोजित की गई थी।
2. संधारणीय जीवन शैली को बढ़ावा देना, वनीकरण और वन अग्नि प्रबंधन, चक्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था (Circular Economy) और जलवायु अनुकूलन (Climate Adaptation) को प्रमुख प्राथमिकता वाले क्षेत्रों के रूप में पहचाना गया था।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is equally true, identifying critical environmental priorities for the BRICS bloc.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 accurately states the 2026 BRICS Chairship theme under India's hosting.
• Option C is Correct because India hosted the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi under the specified theme, with Union Minister Bhupender Yadav presiding, focusing on the four vital areas mentioned in statement 2.
• Option D is Incorrect as both statements are completely accurate.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the initiation of Census processes in Ladakh for Census 2027:
1. Ladakh has become the first Union Territory in India to launch the self-enumeration phase for Census 2027.
2. Due to harsh winter conditions and difficult terrain, the region has been assigned a special reference date of October 1.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
जनगणना 2027 के लिए लद्दाख में जनगणना प्रक्रियाओं की शुरुआत के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. लद्दाख जनगणना 2027 के लिए स्व-गणना चरण शुरू करने वाला भारत का पहला केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बन गया है।
2. कठोर सर्दियों की स्थिति और कठिन भूभाग के कारण, इस क्षेत्र को 1 अक्टूबर की एक विशेष संदर्भ तिथि सौंपी गई है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct regarding the special reference date.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding Ladakh being the first UT to launch self-enumeration for Census 2027.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the strategic digital census exercise, creation of 637 Enumeration Blocks, and the special reference date mandated due to harsh terrain.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually sound.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY): 
1. It is designed to uplift economically weaker backward classes by providing financial assistance for education, skill development, and entrepreneurship.
2. The scheme offers up to ₹1.5 lakh per family for education and skill training, along with additional support for self-employment.
3. Eligibility strictly requires beneficiary families to belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or Other Backward Classes below the poverty line.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
प्रधानमंत्री अनुसूचित जाति अभ्युदय योजना (PM-AJAY) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इसे शिक्षा, कौशल विकास और उद्यमिता के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करके आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर पिछड़े वर्गों के उत्थान के लिए शुरू किया गया है।
2. यह योजना शिक्षा और कौशल प्रशिक्षण के लिए प्रति परिवार ₹1.5 लाख तक तथा स्व-रोजगार के लिए अतिरिक्त सहायता प्रदान करती है।
3. पात्रता के लिए अनिवार्य है कि लाभार्थी परिवार गरीबी रेखा से नीचे जीवन बसर करने वाले अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों या अन्य पिछड़े वर्गों से संबंधित हों।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also factually correct regarding the targeted disadvantaged groups and poverty line criteria.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is an integral part of the overarching objectives of the PM-AJAY convergence framework.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 correctly reflects the financial provision allocations made under the scheme architecture.
• Option D is Correct because all stated provisions accurately describe the target beneficiaries, financial assistance limits up to ₹1.5 lakh for skill development/education, and overall objectives of the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY).

national_questions.qe:
With reference to Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPI) trends in Indian equities, consider the following statements:
1. FPIs remained net buyers in Indian equities during the first two weeks of August.
2. A major portion of this inflow was routed exclusively through secondary stock-exchange purchases, with zero contribution from the primary market.
3. This investment trend was supported by resilient domestic economic fundamentals and robust quarterly corporate earnings.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारतीय इक्विटी में विदेशी पोर्टफोलियो निवेशकों (FPI) के रुझानों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. FPI अगस्त के पहले दो हफ्तों के दौरान भारतीय इक्विटी में शुद्ध खरीदार बने रहे।
2. इस प्रवाह का एक बड़ा हिस्सा विशेष रूप से द्वितीयक स्टॉक-एक्सचेंज खरीद के माध्यम से आया था, जिसमें प्राथमिक बाजार का कोई योगदान नहीं था।
3. इस निवेश रुझान को लचीले घरेलू आर्थिक बुनियादी सिद्धांतों और मजबूत तिमाही कॉर्पोरेट आय का समर्थन प्राप्त था।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statements 1 and 3 accurately reflect that FPIs were net buyers in August backed by strong domestic fundamentals and quarterly earnings, whereas statement 2 is false since significant capital also flowed via the primary market (₹5,422 crore out of ₹16,621 crore).
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 contains factual inaccuracies regarding primary market inflows.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is incorrect and cannot be grouped as a valid statement.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually flawed.
