national_questions.qe: In the opening match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup held in Amstelveen, Netherlands, India played against which country, and what was the final scoreline?
national_questions.qh: नीदरलैंड के आम्सटेलवीन में आयोजित FIH महिला हॉकी विश्व कप के शुरुआती मैच में भारत ने किस देश के खिलाफ खेला, और अंतिम स्कोर क्या रहा?
oh: भारत ने ऑस्ट्रेलिया को 3-1 से हराया
भारत ने चीन के साथ 2-2 से ड्रॉ खेला
भारत अर्जेंटीना से 1-2 से हार गया
भारत ने नीदरलैंड्स के साथ 1-1 से ड्रॉ खेला
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as Australia was not India's opening opponent in this specific tournament context.
• Option B is Correct because India secured a hard-fought 2-2 draw against China in their opening match of the FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup in Amstelveen, Netherlands, with goals from Navneet and Deepika for India, and responses via penalty strokes from Zhang Ying and Ma Ning for China.
• Option C is Incorrect because the match did not end in a defeat against Argentina.
• Option D is Incorrect because the scoreline and opponent country are factually incorrect.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following match-ups of Indian shuttlers at the BWF Badminton World Championships held in New Delhi:
1. PV Sindhu vs Sophia Noble (Ireland)
2. Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand vs Paula Lopez and Lucia Rodriguez (Spain)
3. Ayush Shetty vs Shi Yu Qi (China)
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
national_questions.qh:
नई दिल्ली में आयोजित BWF बैडमिंटन विश्व चैंपियनशिप में भारतीय शटलरों के निम्नलिखित मुकाबलों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. पी.वी. सिंधु बनाम सोफिया नोबल (आयरलैंड)
2. त्रिशा जॉली और गायत्री गोपीचंद बनाम पाउला लोपेज और लूसिया रोड्रिग्ज (स्पेन)
3. आयुष शेट्टी बनाम शी यू क्यूई (चीन)
ऊपर दिए गए युग्मों में से कौन सा/से सही सुमेलित है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because pairs 2 and 3 are also factually correct matches as per the tournament draws.
• Option B is Incorrect because pair 3 is also correctly matched.
• Option C is Incorrect because pair 1 is also correctly matched.
• Option D is Correct because all three designated fixtures—PV Sindhu facing Sophia Noble, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand playing against Paula Lopez and Lucia Rodriguez, and Ayush Shetty taking on World No. 1 Shi Yu Qi—are accurately mapped.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the initiatives associated with the National Anubhav Awards 2026 organized in New Delhi:
1. Release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra.
2. Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five.
3. Organization of a Bank Exhibition by 17 Pension Disbursing Banks showcasing retirement products and services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
नई दिल्ली में आयोजित राष्ट्रीय अनुभव पुरस्कार 2026 से जुड़ी पहलों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. 'पेंशन मित्र' हैंडबुक का विमोचन।
2. राष्ट्रव्यापी डिजिटल जीवन प्रमाण पत्र (DLC) अभियान-फाइव के लिए दिशानिर्देश।
3. सेवानिवृत्त होने वाले कर्मचारियों के लिए उत्पादों और सेवाओं का प्रदर्शन करने वाले 17 पेंशन वितरण बैंकों द्वारा बैंक प्रदर्शनी का आयोजन।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also an authentic component of the event features.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is a correct feature of the ministerial launch event.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is equally verified as correct.
• Option D is Correct because all three initiatives—the release of the Handbook on Pension Mitra, issuance of guidelines for the Nationwide DLC Campaign-Five, and the Bank Exhibition featuring 17 pension disbursing banks—were part of the National Anubhav Awards 2026 conference.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to India's hosting of the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers Meeting in New Delhi, consider the following statements:
1. The ministerial meeting is preceded by the BRICS Senior Officers' Meeting of the Environment Working Group and Contact Group on Climate Change and Sustainable Development.
2. The entire event is structured under the overarching theme of India's BRICS Chairship 2026 – 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
नई दिल्ली में 12वें ब्रिक्स पर्यावरण मंत्रियों की बैठक की भारत की मेजबानी के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. मंत्रिस्तरीय बैठक से पहले पर्यावरण कार्य समूह और जलवायु परिवर्तन तथा सतत विकास पर संपर्क समूह की ब्रिक्स वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों की बैठक होती है।
2. संपूर्ण कार्यक्रम भारत की ब्रिक्स अध्यक्षता 2026 के व्यापक विषय - 'बिल्डिंग फॉर रेजिलिएंस, इनोवेशन, कोऑपरेशन एंड सस्टेनेबिलिटी' के तहत संरचित है।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as statement 2 is also completely accurate regarding India's BRICS Chairship theme.
• Option B is Incorrect as statement 1 is factually verified regarding the Senior Officers' preparatory meetings.
• Option C is Correct because both statements correctly highlight the preparatory working groups/contact groups and the official theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' for India's BRICS Chairship 2026.
• Option D is Incorrect because neither statement is false.

national_questions.qe: The annual pilgrimage to the Himalayan shrine of 'Budha Amarnath', which recently commenced under tight multi-tier security arrangements, is primarily located in which region of Jammu and Kashmir?
national_questions.qh: हिमालयी तीर्थस्थल 'बुड्ढा अमरनाथ' की वार्षिक तीर्थयात्रा, जो हाल ही में कड़े बहु-स्तरीय सुरक्षा व्यवस्था के बीच शुरू हुई है, मुख्य रूप से जम्मू और कश्मीर के किस क्षेत्र में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the Amarnath Yatra covers the Anantnag/Pahalgam axis, whereas Budha Amarnath pertains to a different regional route.
• Option B is Correct because the 12-day-long annual Shri Buddha Amarnath Yatra takes place in the Poonch and Rajouri districts of Jammu and Kashmir, culminating on Raksha Bandhan under multi-tier surveillance.
• Option C is Incorrect as Kishtwar and Doda are not the primary transit hubs for the Buddha Amarnath pilgrimage.
• Option D is Incorrect because Baramulla and Kupwara are situated in the northern Kashmir valley, not the Pir Panjal southern range where this Yatra is held.

national_questions.qe: According to the recent weather warnings issued by the India Meteorological Department (IMD), which of the following regions have been placed under a red colour warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) द्वारा जारी हालिया मौसम चेतावनियों के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र को अत्यधिक भारी वर्षा के लिए 'रेड कलर वार्निंग' के तहत रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the India Meteorological Department (IMD) explicitly issued a red alert for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chhattisgarh and East Madhya Pradesh received an orange alert level warning rather than a red alert.
• Option C is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand were placed under an orange alert warning for very heavy precipitation, not a red alert.
• Option D is Incorrect because Himachal Pradesh and Gujarat fall under heavy rainfall forecast zones without a red warning status in this bulletin.

national_questions.qe: Regarding the National Testing Agency (NTA) and the conduct of the UGC-NET examination, which of the following statements is correct?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय परीक्षण एजेंसी (NTA) और UGC-NET परीक्षा के संचालन के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
oe: UGC-NET is exclusively conducted for granting admissions to undergraduate engineering programs across central universities.
The NTA announced re-tests for specific UGC-NET papers including English, Commerce, and Sociology due to administrative or evaluation errors.
The UGC-NET examination is conducted entirely in a pen-and-paper mode since its inception without any computer-based testing.
The National Testing Agency functions directly under the administrative control of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
oh: UGC-NET विशेष रूप से केंद्रीय विश्वविद्यालयों में स्नातक इंजीनियरिंग कार्यक्रमों में प्रवेश देने के लिए आयोजित किया जाता है।
NTA ने प्रशासनिक या मूल्यांकन त्रुटियों के कारण अंग्रेजी, वाणिज्य और समाजशास्त्र सहित विशिष्ट UGC-NET पत्रों के लिए पुनः परीक्षा की घोषणा की।
UGC-NET परीक्षा अपनी स्थापना के बाद से बिना किसी कंप्यूटर-आधारित परीक्षण के पूरी तरह से पेन-एंड-पेपर मोड में आयोजित की जाती है।
राष्ट्रीय परीक्षण एजेंसी सीधे कौशल विकास और उद्यमिता मंत्रालय के प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण के तहत कार्य करती है।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Testing Agency (NTA) announced re-tests for specific UGC-NET papers—specifically English, Commerce, and Sociology—following evaluation or administrative discrepancies to ensure fairness for all candidates.
• Option A is Incorrect because UGC-NET is a national-level eligibility test for determining the eligibility of Indian nationals for Assistant Professor and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Indian universities and colleges, not for undergraduate engineering.
• Option C is Incorrect because the UGC-NET examination is conducted in Computer Based Test (CBT) mode, not a traditional pen-and-paper format.
• Option D is Incorrect because the NTA functions under the Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India, not the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

national_questions.qe:
In the context of the upcoming Census exercise in India, consider the following statements regarding the digital self-enumeration process in Ladakh:
1. Ladakh has been designated to pioneer the digital self-enumeration phase for Census 2027.
2. Self-enumeration allows citizens to fill out census questionnaires digitally ahead of the formal enumeration blocks processing.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में आगामी जनगणना अभ्यास के संदर्भ में, लद्दाख में डिजिटल स्व-गणना प्रक्रिया के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. लद्दाख को जनगणना 2027 के लिए डिजिटल स्व-गणना चरण की शुरुआत करने के लिए नामित किया गया है।
2. स्व-गणना नागरिकों को औपचारिक गणना ब्लॉक प्रसंस्करण से पहले डिजिटल रूप से जनगणना प्रश्नावली भरने की अनुमति देती है।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Both statements 1 and 2 are correct. Ladakh is set to pioneer the digital self-enumeration framework for Census 2027, becoming the first Union Territory to undertake this digitally integrated exercise. The self-enumeration window allows citizens to log in and securely provide their demographic and household details digitally before the enumerators officially visit the designated Enumeration Blocks (EBs).
• Distractor options claiming either statement to be false are negated by official administrative rollouts for Census preparations in Union Territories.

national_questions.qe: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) recently uncovered large-scale duty evasion involving areca nut imports by misdeclaring the country of origin to exploit provisions under which major regional trade pact?
national_questions.qh: राजस्व खुफिया निदेशालय (DRI) ने हाल ही में किस प्रमुख क्षेत्रीय व्यापार समझौते के प्रावधानों का फायदा उठाने के लिए मूल देश की गलत घोषणा करके सुपारी के आयात से जुड़े बड़े पैमाने पर शुल्क चोरी का भंडाफोड़ किया?
oe: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with UAE
oh: UAE के साथ व्यापक आर्थिक भागीदारी समझौता (CEPA)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the DRI investigations revealed that syndicates were defrauding the exchequer of thousands of crores by mis-declaring the country of origin (e.g., routing Indonesian, Thai, or Malaysian areca nuts through Bangladesh) to improperly exploit duty exemptions under the South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA) agreement.
• Option A is Incorrect as NAFTA pertains to North America and has no applicability to South Asian trade routes or Indian customs.
• Option C and D are Incorrect because the specific duty evasion nexus uncovered by the DRI targeted preferential tariff benefits uniquely tied to the SAFTA framework rather than CEPA or AIFTA mechanisms.

national_questions.qe:
Under the established Broadcasting Codes and Code of Conduct governing public broadcasters like All India Radio (AIR), which of the following types of content are strictly restricted or prohibited?
1. Direct criticism of friendly foreign countries
2. Content inciting violence or undermining public law and order
3. Material considered obscene, defamatory, or attacking specific religions and communities
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो (AIR) जैसे सार्वजनिक प्रसारकों को नियंत्रित करने वाले स्थापित प्रसारण कोड और आचार संहिता के तहत, निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की सामग्री पर कड़े प्रतिबंध या रोक है?
1. मित्र विदेशी देशों की प्रत्यक्ष आलोचना
2. हिंसा भड़काने वाली या सार्वजनिक कानून व्यवस्था को कमजोर करने वाली सामग्री
3. अश्लील, मानहानिकारक या विशिष्ट धर्मों और समुदायों पर हमला करने वाली सामग्री
नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग করে सही उत्तर चुनें:
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because All India Radio's Code of Conduct strictly prohibits the broadcast of any content that undermines international relations (criticism of friendly countries), threatens internal security (incitement to violence and law and order disruptions), or violates social harmony and decency (obscene, defamatory statements, or attacks on religions and communities).
• Options A, B, and C are incomplete as they omit one or more of the core statutory or ethical prohibitions mandated for public broadcasting organizations in India.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Amrit Udyan', located within the Rashtrapati Bhavan complex:
1. It was formerly known as the Mughal Gardens and was designed keeping architectural influences from Mughal and Persian gardens.
2. The gardens are opened exclusively for the winter season and remain closed during summer annual editions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
राष्ट्रपति भवन परिसर के भीतर स्थित 'अमृत उद्यान' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. इसे पहले मुगल गार्डन के रूप में जाना जाता था और इसे मुगल और फारसी उद्यानों के वास्तुशिल्प प्रभावों को ध्यान में रखकर डिजाइन किया गया था।
2. ये उद्यान विशेष रूप से सर्दियों के मौसम के लिए खोले जाते हैं और ग्रीष्मकालीन वार्षिक संस्करणों के दौरान बंद रहते हैं।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is correct: Amrit Udyan (formerly Mughal Gardens) at Rashtrapati Bhavan incorporates features of both Mughal and British garden styles, drawing inspiration from the gardens in Jammu and Kashmir, the Taj Mahal, and miniature paintings. 
• Statement 2 is incorrect: The gardens are not restricted only to winter; they are opened for special public viewing editions such as the 'Amrit Udyan Summer Annuals Edition' during specific periods (e.g., running through summer months up to September), alongside the main spring season opening.

national_questions.qe: With reference to recent government welfare and educational policy initiatives aimed at competitive exam aspirants, which of the following best describes the core objective of the announced free online coaching schemes for economically weaker sections?
national_questions.qh: प्रतियोगिता परीक्षा के उम्मीदवारों के उद्देश्य से हाल की सरकारी कल्याणकारी और शैक्षणिक नीति पहलों के संदर्भ में, आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों के लिए घोषित मुफ्त ऑनलाइन कोचिंग योजनाओं के मुख्य उद्देश्य का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
oe: To completely replace formal university education with digital certification portals.
To ease the heavy financial burden on poor and middle-class families by providing free online coaching for competitive examinations.
To mandate private coaching institutes to reserve 50% seats for international students.
To establish physical coaching hubs funded entirely by foreign direct investment (FDI).
oh: डिजिटल प्रमाणन पोर्टलों के साथ औपचारिक विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षा को पूरी तरह से बदलना।
प्रतियोगिता परीक्षाओं के लिए मुफ्त ऑनलाइन कोचिंग प्रदान करके गरीब और मध्यम वर्ग के परिवारों पर भारी वित्तीय बोझ को कम करना।
निजी कोचिंग संस्थानों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय छात्रों के लिए 50% सीटें आरक्षित करने के लिए अनिवार्य करना।
पूर्णतः प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (FDI) द्वारा वित्त पोषित भौतिक कोचिंग केंद्र स्थापित करना।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the government's free online coaching initiative is directly designed to support students from poor and middle-class backgrounds, shielding them from exorbitant commercial coaching fees and saving thousands of crores for households.
• Option A is Incorrect because online coaching supplements and assists exam preparation; it does not replace formal university education or degrees.
• Option C and D are Incorrect as they introduce arbitrary mandates and FDI concepts completely unrelated to domestic online welfare coaching policies.

national_questions.qe: The 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign, frequently promoted by government media wings such as the Press Information Bureau (PIB) as part of broader national celebrations, primarily operates under the aegis of which major national observance initiative?
national_questions.qh: प्रेस सूचना ब्यूरो (PIB) जैसे सरकारी मीडिया अंगों द्वारा व्यापक राष्ट्रीय उत्सवों के हिस्से के रूप में बार-बार प्रचारित 'Har Ghar Tiranga' अभियान, मुख्य रूप से किस प्रमुख राष्ट्रीय उत्सव पहल के तत्वावधान में संचालित होता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign was conceived and executed under the aegis of 'Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav', an initiative of the Government of India to celebrate and commemorate 75 years of independent India and the glorious history of its people, culture, and achievements.
• Option A is Incorrect as Swachh Bharat Abhiyan focuses on nationwide cleanliness and sanitation.
• Option C is Incorrect as Atmanirbhar Bharat focuses on economic self-reliance.
• Option D is Incorrect as Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat aims to enhance cultural bonding between states.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the organizational structure and mandate of the News Services Division (NSD) of All India Radio (AIR):
1. It functions as the premier news-gathering and broadcasting arm, aiming to deliver objective news and views across the country.
2. The division is headed by the Director General (News), who belongs to the Indian Information Service (IIS) cadre.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो (AIR) के समाचार सेवा प्रभाग (NSD) की संगठनात्मक संरचना और अधिदेश पर विचार करें:
1. यह एक प्रमुख समाचार-संग्रहण और प्रसारण शाखा के रूप में कार्य करता है, जिसका उद्देश्य पूरे देश में निष्पक्ष समाचार और विचार पहुंचाना है।
2. इस प्रभाग का नेतृत्व महानिदेशक (समाचार) द्वारा किया जाता है, जो भारतीय सूचना सेवा (IIS) संवर्ग से संबंधित होते हैं।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Both statements 1 and 2 are correct. The News Services Division (NSD) of AIR strives to provide news and views to every citizen across the country adhering to strict professional broadcasting ethics. Furthermore, the division is headed by the Director General (News), designated as one of the senior-most officers of the Indian Information Service (IIS).
• Distractor choices claiming either statement to be incorrect are factually invalid regarding public broadcaster hierarchies in India.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the All India Radio (AIR) Code for Programming, consider the following statements:
1. The code explicitly prohibits any criticism of friendly foreign countries.
2. It bans content that attacks religions or communities, as well as anything obscene or defamatory.
3. Aspersions against the integrity of the President, Governors, and the Judiciary are strictly barred under this code.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
ऑल इंडिया रेडियो (AIR) प्रोग्रामिंग कोड के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
1. यह कोड किसी भी मित्र देश की आलोचना पर स्पष्ट रूप से प्रतिबंध लगाता है।
2. यह धर्मों या समुदायों पर हमला करने वाली सामग्री के साथ-साथ किसी भी अशिष्ट या मानहानिकारक सामग्री पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है।
3. राष्ट्रपति, राज्यपालों और न्यायपालिका की अखंडता पर लांछन लगाना इस कोड के तहत पूरी तरह से वर्जित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also correct along with 1 and 2.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also legally and operationally part of the AIR code prohibiting criticism of friendly nations.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is equally valid and forms the core of content regulation against obscenity and communal disharmony.
• Option D is Correct because the All India Radio (AIR) Code strictly prohibits criticism of friendly countries, attacks on religions or communities, obscenity, defamation, incitement to violence, contempt of court, and aspersions against constitutional functionaries like the President, Governors, and the Judiciary, aiming to uphold public order and constitutional respect.

national_questions.qe: In the context of India's long-term energy transition and technological vision towards 'Viksit Bharat 2047', what is the recently announced target for nuclear power capacity by the year 2047?
national_questions.qh: भारत के दीर्घकालिक ऊर्जा संक्रमण और 'विकसित भारत 2047' की ओर तकनीकी दृष्टिकोण के संदर्भ में, वर्ष 2047 तक परमाणु ऊर्जा क्षमता के लिए हाल ही में घोषित लक्ष्य क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because 50 GW is lower than the strategic milestone declared by the government for nuclear energy expansion.
• Option B is Correct because during the Independence Day address at the Red Fort, the government announced an ambitious target of achieving 100 gigawatts (GW) of nuclear power capacity by the year 2047 to ensure base-load clean energy security.
• Option C is Incorrect as 150 GW has not been designated as the official nuclear capacity target for 2047 in the stated policy announcements.
• Option D is Incorrect because 200 GW exceeds the current blueprint estimations set by atomic energy authorities for the 2047 horizon.

national_questions.qe: With reference to India's long-term energy transition and recent policy announcements made during Independence Day addresses, what is the targeted nuclear power capacity set by the Government of India to be achieved by the year 2047?
national_questions.qh: भारत के दीर्घकालिक ऊर्जा संक्रमण और स्वतंत्रता दिवस के संबोधन के दौरान की गई हालिया नीतिगत घोषणाओं के संदर्भ में, वर्ष 2047 तक प्राप्त किए जाने वाले परमाणु ऊर्जा क्षमता का लक्ष्य भारत सरकार द्वारा क्या निर्धारित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Government of India has set an ambitious target to achieve 100 gigawatts (GW) of nuclear power capacity by the year 2047, coinciding with the centenary of India's independence, as part of the broader clean energy transition towards 'Viksit Bharat'.
• Option A is Incorrect because 50 GW does not reflect the announced long-term nuclear target for 2047.
• Option B is Incorrect because 75 GW is a distractor figure not aligned with the official nuclear capacity roadmap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 150 GW overestimates the targeted nuclear capacity milestone set for 2047.

national_questions.qe: Consider the following statements regarding wartime and peacetime gallantry awards in India: Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar was recently awarded the Shaurya Chakra. The Shaurya Chakra is awarded for which of the following categories of bravery?
national_questions.qh: भारत में युद्धकालीन और शांति कालीन वीरता पुरस्कारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें: स्क्वाड्रन लीडर सुधीर कुमार को हाल ही में शौर्य चक्र से सम्मानित किया गया। शौर्य चक्र किस श्रेणी की बहादुरी के लिए प्रदान किया जाता है?
oe: Most conspicuous bravery or some daring or pre-eminent act of valour or self-sacrifice in the presence of the enemy, whether on land, at sea or in the air.
Gallantry otherwise than in the presence of the enemy, specifically for exceptional valor, courage, or self-sacrifice.
Exceptional devotion to duty and gallantry specifically during counter-insurgency operations within Jammu and Kashmir only.
Outstanding service of the most exceptional order during peacetime naval operations and maritime reconnaissance.
oh: शत्रु की उपस्थिति में भूमि, समुद्र या आकाश में वीरता या आत्म-बलिदान का अत्यंत विशिष्ट कार्य।
शत्रु की उपस्थिति के अलावा अन्य परिस्थितियों में असाधारण वीरता, साहस या आत्म-बलिदान के लिए।
विशेष रूप से केवल जम्मू और कश्मीर के भीतर आतंकवाद-रोधी अभियानों के दौरान कर्तव्य के प्रति असाधारण समर्पण और वीरता।
शांतिकालीन नौसेना अभियानों और समुद्री टोही के दौरान अत्यंत असाधारण कोटि की उत्कृष्ट सेवा।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Shaurya Chakra is India's third-highest peacetime gallantry award (after Ashoka Chakra and Kirti Chakra), awarded to military and civilian personnel for valour, courageous action, or self-sacrifice otherwise than in the presence of the enemy, such as Squadron Leader Sudhir Kumar's exceptional recovery of a Su-30MKI jet from a critical crash.
• Option A is Incorrect because it describes the Param Vir Chakra, which is India's highest wartime gallantry award.
• Option C is Incorrect because Shaurya Chakra is not restricted solely to counter-insurgency operations in Jammu and Kashmir and applies nationwide across all armed forces and eligible civilians.
• Option D is Incorrect because peacetime gallantry awards are not limited to naval operations alone.

national_questions.qe: In the context of India's strategic defense policy and the goal of achieving 'Viksit Bharat', what is the primary objective associated with the concept of 'Raksha Shakti' and initiatives like 'Mission Sudarshan Chakra'?
national_questions.qh: भारत की रणनीतिक रक्षा नीति और 'विकसित भारत' के लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के संदर्भ में, 'रक्षा शक्ति' की अवधारणा और 'मिशन सुदर्शन चक्र' जैसी पहलों से जुड़ा प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: To completely phase out indigenous defense production in favor of direct government-to-government military imports from allied superpowers.
To transform India into a global supplier of next-generation defense technology, enhance indigenous military capabilities, and foster self-reliance in defense.
To restrict Indian defense manufacturing strictly to the public sector undertakings (PSUs) while barring private participation.
To establish regional military pacts focused exclusively on joint anti-piracy patrols in the Indian Ocean Region.
oh: मित्र महाशक्तियों से प्रत्यक्ष सरकार-से-सरकार सैन्य आयातों के पक्ष में स्वदेशी रक्षा उत्पादन को पूरी तरह से चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त करना।
भारत को अगली पीढ़ी की रक्षा तकनीक का वैश्विक सप्लायर बनाना, स्वदेशी सैन्य क्षमताओं को बढ़ाना और रक्षा के क्षेत्र में आत्मनिर्भरता को बढ़ावा देना।
निजी भागीदारी पर प्रतिबंध लगाते हुए भारतीय रक्षा विनिर्माण को कड़ाई से सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों (PSUs) तक सीमित रखना।
हिंद महासागर क्षेत्र में संयुक्त समुद्री डकैती रोधी गश्ती अभियानों पर विशेष रूप से केंद्रित क्षेत्रीय सैन्य समझौते स्थापित करना।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because 'Raksha Shakti' and strategic programs like 'Mission Sudarshan Chakra' emphasize augmenting indigenous military capabilities, modernizing defense infrastructure, and positioning India as a leading global exporter and supplier of next-generation defense technologies toward 'Viksit Bharat'.
• Option A is Incorrect as India's defense policy strongly promotes 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' (self-reliance) rather than depending entirely on imports.
• Option C is Incorrect because recent defense reforms actively encourage private sector participation, startups, and MSMEs in defense manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mission Sudarshan Chakra and Raksha Shakti are broader national defense and security modernization frameworks, not limited to anti-piracy patrols.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the PM Internship Scheme, which aims to bridge the industry-skill gap:
1. It is implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
2. It is exclusively open to candidates falling within the 18 to 25 age group.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
पीएम इंटर्नशिप योजना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें, जिसका उद्देश्य उद्योग-कौशल अंतर को पाटना है:
1. इसे कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय द्वारा कार्यान्वित किया जाता है।
2. यह विशेष रूप से 18 से 25 वर्ष की आयु वर्ग के अंतर्गत आने वाले उम्मीदवारों के लिए खुली है।
ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because both statements are accurate. The PM Internship Scheme is indeed anchored and implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to bridge industry-academia/skill gaps, providing valuable corporate exposure to youth aged 18 to 25 years.
• Option A is Incorrect if chosen as '1 only', because statement 2 is also fully correct.
• Option B is Incorrect if chosen as '2 only', because statement 1 is also accurate.
• Option D is Incorrect because neither statement is false; both correctly identify the nodal ministry and demographic eligibility criteria.

national_questions.qe: With reference to strategic economic policy planning in India, which premier institution is responsible for releasing reports and frameworks focused on positioning India as a global manufacturing hub to fulfill the vision of 'Viksit Bharat'?
national_questions.qh: भारत में रणनीतिक आर्थिक नीति नियोजन के संदर्भ में, 'विकसित भारत' के विजन को पूरा करने के लिए भारत को एक वैश्विक विनिर्माण केंद्र के रूप में स्थापित करने पर केंद्रित रिपोर्ट और रूपरेखा जारी करने के लिए कौन सा प्रमुख संस्थान जिम्मेदार है?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, tasked with formulating strategic reports, industrial roadmaps, and policy interventions to position India as a global manufacturing hub under the 'Viksit Bharat' vision.
• Option A is Incorrect because the RBI is India's central banking institution regulating monetary policy and currency, not industrial manufacturing hubs.
• Option C is Incorrect because SEBI is the statutory regulator for securities markets and investor protection.
• Option D is Incorrect because CCI enforces antitrust laws and regulates fair market competition, not macroeconomic manufacturing policy reports.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Gallantry awards approved on the eve of the 80th Independence Day, consider the following statements: 
1. These awards are presented exclusively to officers of the Indian Army.
2. The awards approved include Kirti Chakras, Shaurya Chakras, and Sena Medals (Gallantry).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
80वीं स्वतंत्रता दिवस की पूर्व संध्या पर स्वीकृत वीरता पुरस्कारों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. ये पुरस्कार विशेष रूप से भारतीय सेना के अधिकारियों को प्रदान किए जाते हैं।
2. स्वीकृत पुरस्कारों में कीर्ति चक्र, शौर्य चक्र और सेना मेडल (वीरता) शामिल हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Gallantry awards are given not just to the Indian Army, but to eligible personnel from all three services of the Defence Forces as well as Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).
• Option B is Correct because the President approved 78 Gallantry awards which notably include Kirti Chakras, Shaurya Chakras, Bars to Sena Medals (Gallantry), and Sena Medals (Gallantry) for personnel displaying exceptional courage.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 1 is factually wrong regarding exclusive Army restriction.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is accurate.

national_questions.qe:
Regarding the recent regulatory changes concerning television broadcasting in India, consider the following statements:
1. The 12-minute advertisement duration cap for television channels was originally introduced under the Cable Television Networks Rules.
2. The removal of this advertising cap aims to promote ease of doing business and fair competition within the broadcasting sector.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में टेलीविज़न प्रसारण से संबंधित हालिया विनियामक परिवर्तनों के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. टेलीविज़न चैनलों के लिए 12 मिनट की विज्ञापन अवधि की सीमा मूल रूप से केबल टेलीविज़न नेटवर्क नियमों के तहत शुरू की गई थी।
2. इस विज्ञापन सीमा को हटाने का उद्देश्य प्रसारण क्षेत्र के भीतर व्यवसाय करने में सुगमता और निष्पक्ष प्रतिस्पर्धा को बढ़ावा देना है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because while statement 1 is correct, statement 2 is also correct making option C the right choice.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also valid alongside statement 2.
• Option C is Correct because the 12-minute advertisement cap was indeed introduced in 2006 under the Cable Television Networks Rules, 1994, and its removal has been enacted to boost the ease of doing business and accommodate the massive growth of TV channels in India.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately reflect the regulatory amendment.

national_questions.qe: The Sinquefield Cup, frequently seen in news regarding elite chess tournaments, is traditionally associated with which format of chess competition and notable achievements by grandmasters like R. Praggnanandhaa?
national_questions.qh: समाचारों में अक्सर देखे जाने वाले सिंकफिल्ड कप (Sinquefield Cup) का संबंध पारंपरिक रूप से शतरंज की किस प्रतिस्पर्धी विधा और आर. प्रज्ञानानंद जैसे ग्रैंडमास्टर्स की उल्लेखनीय उपलब्धियों से है?
oe: Standard Classical Chess tournament featuring top-tier international Grandmasters
Rapid Online Chess championship organized exclusively by FIDE online platform
Blitz Chess circuit held annually during the World Chess Olympiad
Correspondence Chess league managed by national sports federations
oh: शीर्ष स्तर के अंतरराष्ट्रीय ग्रैंडमास्टर्स की विशेषता वाली मानक क्लासिकल शतरंज प्रतियोगिता
विशेष रूप से FIDE ऑनलाइन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म द्वारा आयोजित रैपिड ऑनलाइन शतरंज चैंपियनशिप
विश्व शतरंज ओलंपियाड के दौरान प्रतिवर्ष आयोजित होने वाला ब्लिट्ज़ शतरंज सर्किट
राष्ट्रीय खेल महासंघों द्वारा प्रबंधित पत्राचार शतरंज लीग
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Sinquefield Cup is a prestigious elite classical chess tournament that forms a key leg of the Grand Chess Tour, featuring top international grandmasters like R. Praggnanandhaa and Jorden Van Foreest.
• Option B is Incorrect because it is an over-the-board classical tournament, not an online rapid event.
• Option C is Incorrect because it does not pertain to the Blitz circuit.
• Option D is Incorrect because correspondence chess is unrelated to this physical elite tournament.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS), consider the following statements:
1. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
2. It targets bridging the skill gap for youth belonging to the age group of 21 to 35 years.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
प्रधान मंत्री इंटर्नशिप योजना (PMIS) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इस योजना को कॉर्पोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय द्वारा कार्यान्वित किया जाता है।
2. इसका उद्देश्य 21 से 35 वर्ष की आयु वर्ग के युवाओं के लिए कौशल अंतराल को पाटना है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) is indeed implemented by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs to bridge the industry-skill gap for young candidates.
• Option B is Incorrect because the eligible age group for the PM Internship Scheme is 18 to 25 years, not 21 to 35 years.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 is factually incorrect regarding the age bracket.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is valid.

national_questions.qe: The Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act (MMDR Act) forms the statutory framework for mining sector regulation in India. Under the Constitution of India, the authority to regulate mines and mineral development is vested in:
national_questions.qh: खान और खनिज (विकास और विनियमन) अधिनियम (MMDR Act) भारत में खनन क्षेत्र के विनियमन के लिए विधिक ढांचा प्रदान करता है। भारत के संविधान के तहत, खानों और खनिज विकास को विनियमित करने की शक्ति किसमें निहित है?
oe: Exclusive legislative competence of State Governments only
Union Government for the wider public interest and regulation as enacted by Parliament
Local Panchayati Raj institutions under Schedule V provisions
Joint oversight committees of international mining syndicates
oh: केवल राज्य सरकारों की अनन्य विधाई क्षमता
संसद द्वारा अधिनियमित व्यापक जनहित और विनियमन के लिए केंद्र सरकार
अनुसूची V के प्रावधानों के तहत स्थानीय पंचायती राज संस्थाएँ
अंतरराष्ट्रीय खनन सिंडिकेट की संयुक्त निगरानी समितियाँ
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because while states own minerals within their boundaries, the Union Parliament holds wide powers under Entry 54 of List I to regulate mines and mineral development in the public interest.
• Option B is Correct because the Union controls mine regulation via laws like the MMDR Act, 1957 (and amendments like MMDR Amendment Bill, 2026) to ensure certainty and uniformity in mineral taxation across the nation.
• Option C is Incorrect because Panchayats do not regulate major mineral taxation or national mineral development policy.
• Option D is Incorrect as international syndicates have no constitutional regulation mandate in India.

national_questions.qe: The Cernavoda nuclear power plant, which recently faced shutdowns due to severe drought and record-low water levels in the Danube River, is located in which of the following European countries?
national_questions.qh: चेरनावोडा (Cernavoda) परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र, जिसे हाल ही में गंभीर सूखे और डेन्यूब नदी में रिकॉर्ड-कम जल स्तर के कारण शटडाउन का सामना करना पड़ा, निम्नलिखित में से किस यूरोपीय देश में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Cernavoda is not situated in Ukraine.
• Option B is Correct because the Cernavoda nuclear power plant is Romania's sole nuclear facility, accounting for roughly 20% of the nation's electricity, which faced reactor shutdowns due to extreme low water levels in the Danube River caused by severe drought.
• Option C is Incorrect because it is outside Bulgaria's territory.
• Option D is Incorrect because Hungary does not house the Cernavoda plant.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the recent announcement of Gallantry Awards approved by the President of India on the eve of Independence Day. Which of the following statements regarding the structure and conferment of these awards is/are correct?
1. Kirti Chakra is India's highest peacetime gallantry decoration.
2. The approval included Kirti Chakras and Shaurya Chakras awarded to personnel from Defence Forces and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs), including posthumous awards.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
national_questions.qh:
भारत के राष्ट्रपति द्वारा स्वतंत्रता दिवस की पूर्व संध्या पर स्वीकृत वीरता पुरस्कारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. कीर्ति चक्र भारत का सर्वोच्च शांतिकाल वीरता पदक है।
2. स्वीकृत पुरस्कारों में रक्षा बलों और केंद्रीय अर्धसैनिक बलों (CAPF) के कर्मियों को मरणोपरांत सहित प्रदान किए गए कीर्ति चक्र और शौर्य चक्र शामिल थे।
नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनिए:
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Statement 1 is wrong: Param Vir Chakra is India's highest wartime gallantry decoration, while Ashoka Chakra is India's highest peacetime gallantry decoration. Kirti Chakra is the second-highest peacetime gallantry award.
• Option B is Correct because Statement 2 accurately reflects that the President approved 78 Gallantry awards (including 13 posthumous), which comprise Kirti Chakras, Shaurya Chakras, Sena Medals, etc., for personnel of the Defence Forces and CAPFs.
• Option C is Incorrect because Statement 1 is factually erroneous.
• Option D is Incorrect because Statement 2 is correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to India's strategic manufacturing initiatives, consider the 'Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (REPM)'. Which Ministry administers this scheme, and what is its primary objective?
1. Ministry of Heavy Industries
2. Ministry of Mines
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
national_questions.qh:
भारत की रणनीतिक विनिर्माण पहलों के संदर्भ में, 'सिंtered दुर्लभ पृथ्वी स्थायी चुंबक (REPM) के निर्माण को बढ़ावा देने की योजना' पर विचार कीजिए। कौन सा मंत्रालय इस योजना का संचालन करता है और इसका प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
1. भारी उद्योग मंत्रालय
2. खान मंत्रालय
नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनिए:
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Statement 1 is correct: The Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets is administered by the Ministry of Heavy Industries to strengthen the domestic REPM manufacturing ecosystem and reduce import dependence for critical minerals used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and defense applications. Statement 2 is incorrect as the nodal ministry for this specific manufacturing production scheme is Heavy Industries, not the Ministry of Mines.
• Option B is Incorrect because Statement 2 incorrectly attributes the administrative control to the Ministry of Mines.
• Option C is Incorrect because both statements are not correct.
• Option D is Incorrect because Statement 1 is correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the government reforms aimed at enhancing the Ease of Doing Business in India, consider the following statements:
1. The reforms focus heavily on reducing compliance burdens and improving transparency.
2. Digital single-window systems and simplified incorporation processes are being deployed to streamline business operations.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में व्यवसाय करने में सुगमता (Ease of Doing Business) को बढ़ाने के उद्देश्य से किए गए सरकारी सुधारों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. ये सुधार अनुपालन बोझ (compliance burden) को कम करने और पारदर्शिता में सुधार करने पर केंद्रित हैं।
2. व्यावसायिक संचालन को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए डिजिटल सिंगल-विंडो सिस्टम और सरल निगमन प्रक्रियाओं को तैनात किया जा रहा है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct; digital systems are integral to these reforms.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct; compliance reduction is a primary focus.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the ongoing administrative reforms by the Government of India to reduce compliance burdens, enhance transparency, and deploy digital single-window systems for promoting entrepreneurship and ease of doing business.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements correctly state the governance measures undertaken.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding India's evolving energy landscape and strategic energy security:
1. India is systematically expanding its non-fossil energy capacity as part of its broader transition towards a cleaner and greener future.
2. The ongoing energy transformation is exclusively restricted to the renewable energy sector, excluding conventional hydrocarbons and nuclear power.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत के विकसित होते ऊर्जा परिदृश्य और रणनीतिक ऊर्जा सुरक्षा के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत स्वच्छ और हरित भविष्य की ओर अपने व्यापक संक्रमण के हिस्से के रूप में व्यवस्थित रूप से अपनी गैर-फासिल (non-fossil) ऊर्जा क्षमता का विस्तार कर रहा है।
2. चल रहा ऊर्जा परिवर्तन विशेष रूप से केवल अक्षय ऊर्जा क्षेत्र तक ही सीमित है, जिसमें पारंपरिक हाइड्रोकार्बन और परमाणु ऊर्जा शामिल नहीं हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is correct; India is actively expanding its non-fossil fuel energy capacity to meet rising demands while supporting global climate commitments. Statement 2 is incorrect because the energy transformation spans across multiple vectors including renewable energy, nuclear power, petroleum, natural gas, coal, and emerging technologies, rather than being restricted solely to renewables.
• Option B is Incorrect as statement 2 contains a false restriction.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is factually flawed.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is valid.

national_questions.qe: In the context of natural rubber production in India, which of the following states holds the position of the third-highest rubber producing state?
national_questions.qh: भारत में प्राकृतिक रबर उत्पादन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा राज्य रबर उत्पादन में तीसरा सबसे बड़ा राज्य है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Kerala ranks as the highest rubber-producing state in India, not the third.
• Option B is Incorrect because Tripura occupies the second position in natural rubber production nationwide.
• Option C is Correct because Assam is recognized as India's third-highest rubber-producing state, coming in after Kerala and Tripura, contributing significantly to the country's natural rubber output.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu is not the third-highest producer in this specific ranking.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the implementation of the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) - Digital Rupee (e₹):
1. The Digital Rupee is being deployed for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY).
2. Chandigarh has been designated to undertake a full-fledged roll-out of the Digital Rupee for these welfare transactions, marking a significant evolution in welfare delivery.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
केंद्रीय बैंक डिजिटल मुद्रा (CBDC) - डिजिटल रुपया (e₹) के कार्यान्वयन के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. प्रधानमंत्री गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना (PMGKAY) के तहत प्रत्यक्ष लाभ हस्तांतरण (DBT) के लिए डिजिटल रुपये का उपयोग किया जा रहा है।
2. चंडीगढ़ को इन कल्याणकारी लेन-देन के लिए डिजिटल रुपये के पूर्ण पैमाने पर रोल-आउट को करने के लिए नामित किया गया है, जो कल्याणकारी वितरण में एक महत्वपूर्ण विकास को दर्शाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct.
• Option C is Correct because both statements are factually accurate regarding the innovative integration of the Central Bank Digital Currency (Digital Rupee) for welfare delivery under PMGKAY, with Chandigarh acting as the pioneering Union Territory for its full-fledged deployment.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements describe authentic policy rollouts.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following bodies has identified 12 priority sectors to strengthen the domestic manufacturing ecosystem and position India as a global manufacturing hub under the vision of Viksit Bharat?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस निकाय ने 'विकसित भारत' के दृष्टिकोण के तहत घरेलू विनिर्माण पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को मजबूत करने और भारत को एक वैश्विक विनिर्माण केंद्र के रूप में स्थापित करने के लिए 12 प्राथमिकता वाले क्षेत्रों की पहचान की है?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because RBI is India's central banking institution and is not responsible for outlining industrial manufacturing hub strategies across these 12 priority sectors.
• Option B is Correct because NITI Aayog has specifically identified 12 priority sectors—including automobiles, electronics, capital goods, defence, and pharmaceuticals—to enhance India's manufacturing competitiveness and realize the vision of Viksit Bharat.
• Option C is Incorrect because SEBI is the regulatory body for securities markets.
• Option D is Incorrect because CII is an industry association, whereas the strategic roadmap mentioned originated from NITI Aayog.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following statements regarding India's foreign trade performance in July: 
1. Total exports (merchandise and services combined) were estimated to cross 80 billion US dollars.
2. The growth in merchandise exports was primarily driven by sectors such as petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
जुलाई माह में भारत के विदेशी व्यापार प्रदर्शन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. कुल निर्यात (वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को मिलाकर) 80 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर से अधिक होने का अनुमान लगाया गया था।
2. वस्तु निर्यात (merchandise exports) में वृद्धि मुख्य रूप से पेट्रोलियम उत्पादों, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सामानों और इंजीनियरिंग वस्तुओं जैसे क्षेत्रों द्वारा संचालित थी।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also factually correct alongside statement 1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also valid; total exports were estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars.
• Option C is Correct because total exports including merchandise and services were estimated at 80.14 billion US dollars, and the merchandise shipments jumped over 19.6%, prominently driven by petroleum products, electronic goods, and engineering goods.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately reflect India's trade data for the month.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to India's performance at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship, consider the following statements:
1. India emerged as the overall champions at the tournament.
2. The Indian contingent secured a total of 35 medals, which included 13 gold medals.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
कॉमनवेल्थ फ़ेंसिंग चैंपियनशिप में भारत के प्रदर्शन के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत इस टूर्नामेंट में समग्र चैंपियन (overall champions) के रूप में उभरा।
2. भारतीय दल ने कुल 35 पदक हासिल किए, जिसमें 13 स्वर्ण पदक शामिल थे।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct as India clinched 35 medals including 13 gold.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct as India emerged as overall champions.
• Option C is Correct because India achieved a historic milestone by emerging as the overall champions at the Commonwealth Fencing Championship, securing 35 medals in total, comprising 13 gold, 8 silver, and 14 bronze medals.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually correct.

national_questions.qe: According to the United Nations Security Council's (UNSC) Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team, which terrorist entity has been attributed responsibility for the Red Fort suicide car bombing and evolved into a decentralized regional network?
national_questions.qh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद (UNSC) की विश्लेषणात्मक सहायता और प्रतिबंध निगरानी टीम के अनुसार, लाल किले पर हुए आत्मघाती कार बम विस्फोट के लिए किस आतंकवादी संगठन को जिम्मेदार ठहराया गया है और जो एक विकेंद्रीकृत क्षेत्रीय नेटवर्क के रूप में विकसित हुआ है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as JeM is a separate Pakistan-based terrorist group focused primarily on Jammu and Kashmir, not linked in this specific UNSC monitoring report regarding the Red Fort incident.
• Option B is Incorrect because LeT operates with a distinct command structure and was not the entity cited in this specific UNSC monitoring report.
• Option C is Correct because the UNSC's Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team explicitly attributed the Red Fort suicide car bombing to Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS), highlighting its evolution into a regional entity with established logistics, financial networks, and a scattered operational structure.
• Option D is Incorrect as ISKP is an affiliate of the Islamic State active mainly in Afghanistan and Central Asia.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following pairs regarding recent international tennis tournament winners:
1. Iga Swiatek : Women's Singles at Canadian Open (Toronto)
2. Ben Shelton : Men's Singles at Canadian Open (Montreal)
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
national_questions.qh:
हालिया अंतर्राष्ट्रीय टेनिस टूर्नामेंट विजेताओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित युग्मों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इगा स्वियाटेक : कैनेडियन ओपन (टोरंटो) में महिला एकल
2. बेन शेल्टन : कैनेडियन ओपन (मॉन्ट्रियल) में पुरुष एकल
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से युग्म सही सुमेलित है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because pair 2 is also correct; Ben Shelton won the Men's Singles title in Montreal.
• Option B is Incorrect because pair 1 is also correct; Iga Swiatek won the Women's Singles title in Toronto.
• Option C is Correct because Iga Swiatek (Poland) defeated Elena Rybakina to claim the Women's Singles title in Toronto, and Ben Shelton defeated Brandon Nakashima to successfully defend his crown and capture the Men's Singles title in Montreal.
• Option D is Incorrect because both pairs are correctly matched.

national_questions.qe: The Government of India observes which date of the year as 'Partition Horrors Remembrance Day' to pay homage to those who suffered and sacrificed during the 1947 partition?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार 1947 के विभाजन के दौरान पीड़ित होने वाले और बलिदान देने वालों को श्रद्धांजलि देने के लिए वर्ष की किस तिथि को 'विभाजन विभीषिका स्मृति दिवस' (Partition Horrors Remembrance Day) के रूप में मनाती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Government of India officially designated 14th August every year as Partition Horrors Remembrance Day to remember the pain, sufferings, and sacrifices of millions of people during the partition of India in 1947.
• Option B is Incorrect as 15th August is celebrated as India's Independence Day.
• Option C is Incorrect because 31st October is observed as National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas) to mark the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
• Option D is Incorrect because 25th December is observed as Good Governance Day (Sushasan Diwas) commemorating Atal Bihari Vajpayee's birth anniversary.

national_questions.qe: The Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Awards, which are presented to eminent artists as guardians of Indian tradition and collective memory, are awarded under the aegis of which Union Ministry of India?
national_questions.qh: संगीत नाटक अकादमी फैलोशिप और पुरस्कार, जो भारतीय परंपरा और सामूहिक स्मृति के संरक्षक के रूप में प्रख्यात कलाकारों को प्रदान किए जाते हैं, भारत के किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के तत्वावधान में दिए जाते हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as the Ministry of Science and Technology handles scientific research and technological development.
• Option B is Correct because the Sangeet Natak Akademi is the apex body of performing arts in the country, functioning under the administrative control of the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
• Option C is Incorrect as the Ministry of Education primarily deals with school, higher education, and literacy, though it collaborates on cultural literacy programs.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting manages media, films, and public broadcasting units.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the provisional trade data statistics of India for the period April-July: 
1. Cumulative exports of merchandise and services registered a positive double-digit growth compared to the previous fiscal period.
2. Merchandise exports formed the entirety of India's external sector earnings with zero contribution from the services sector.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
अप्रैल-जुलाई की अवधि के लिए भारत के अनंतिम व्यापार डेटा आँकड़ों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के संचयी निर्यात ने पिछले वित्तीय वर्ष की अवधि की तुलना में सकारात्मक दो अंकों की वृद्धि दर्ज की।
2. वस्तु निर्यात (merchandise exports) ने सेवा क्षेत्र के शून्य योगदान के साथ भारत की बाह्य क्षेत्र की कमाई का संपूर्ण हिस्सा बनाया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because cumulative exports (merchandise and services) during April-July registered robust estimated growth of over 13% compared to the previous year, validating statement 1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 is patently false; India's external trade figures explicitly include both merchandise shipments (such as petroleum, electronics, engineering goods) and a substantial services sector export component.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 contains factually incorrect assertions regarding zero services contribution.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is accurate.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the structural transformation in India's Agriculture and Allied Sectors, consider the following statements:
1. Agriculture and allied sectors provide livelihoods to approximately less than 20 percent of India's total workforce.
2. Allied sectors such as livestock and fisheries have maintained a stable growth rate of 5-6 percent, strengthening rural incomes.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत के कृषि और उससे जुड़े क्षेत्रों में संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. कृषि और संबद्ध क्षेत्र भारत के कुल कार्यबल के लगभग 20 प्रतिशत से कम को आजीविका प्रदान करते हैं।
2. पशुपालन और मत्स्य पालन जैसे संबद्ध क्षेत्रों ने ग्रामीण आय को मजबूत करते हुए 5-6 प्रतिशत की स्थिर विकास दर बनाए रखी है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 1 is factually incorrect; agriculture remains the backbone providing livelihoods to approximately 46.1 percent of India's workforce, not less than 20 percent.
• Option B is Correct because livestock and fisheries have indeed maintained a stable growth of 5-6 percent, driving agricultural diversification and supporting rural incomes over recent years.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 1 is wrong.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is accurate.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 passed by Parliament, consider the following statements:
1. It amends the principal National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
2. It empowers the Corporation to undertake activities relating to industrial goods.
3. It allows the Corporation to provide loans and grants directly to co-operatives.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
national_questions.qh:
संसद द्वारा पारित राष्ट्रीय सहकारी विकास निगम (NCDC) (संशोधन) विधेयक, 2026 के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह मूल राष्ट्रीय सहकारी विकास निगम अधिनियम, 1962 में संशोधन करता है।
2. यह निगम को औद्योगिक वस्तुओं से संबंधित गतिविधियों को शुरू करने का अधिकार देता है।
3. यह निगम को सहकारी समितियों को सीधे ऋण और अनुदान प्रदान करने की अनुमति देता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 3 is also correct along with 1 and 2.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct as the Bill amends the 1962 Act.
• Option C is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct as industrial goods activities have been added.
• Option D is Correct because the National Co-operative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 amends the 1962 Act, enabling the Corporation to expand its scope into industrial goods and directly disburse financial assistance, loans, and grants to cooperative societies bypassing cumbersome multi-tier channels.

national_questions.qe: The 80th Independence Day celebrations in 2026 at the Red Fort commemorate a major historical milestone of which national heritage symbol, alongside the theme 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047'?
national_questions.qh: लाल किले पर वर्ष 2026 में आयोजित 80वें स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह में 'युवा शक्ति फॉर विकसित भारत@2047' थीम के साथ-साथ किस राष्ट्रीय धरोहर प्रतीक की एक प्रमुख ऐतिहासिक मील का पत्थर का स्मरण किया गया?
oe: 75 years of the adoption of the National Flag
150 years of the national song 'Vande Mataram'
100 years of the historic Lahore Session declaration
125 years of the establishment of the Archaeological Survey of India
oh: राष्ट्रीय ध्वज को अपनाने के 75 वर्ष
ऐतिहासिक लाहौर अधिवेशन घोषणा के 100 वर्ष
भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण की स्थापना के 125 वर्ष
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the National Flag adoption milestone does not match the specific 150-year context announced for the 2026 celebrations.
• Option B is Correct because the 80th Independence Day Celebrations at the Red Fort in 2026 commemorate 150 years of the enduring national song 'Vande Mataram' under the overarching theme 'Yuva Shakti for Viksit Bharat@2047', with 'Vande Mataram' rendered prominently for the first time in official commemorative formats.
• Option C is Incorrect as the Lahore Session occurred in 1929 (approx 97 years prior, not 150 years).
• Option D is Incorrect because ASI was established in 1861, which does not align with the 150-year milestone mentioned.

national_questions.qe: India recently signed Terms of Reference (ToR) for negotiations towards a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) with SACU. What countries constitute the Southern African Customs Union (SACU)?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने हाल ही में SACU के साथ अधिमान्य व्यापार समझौते (PTA) की वार्ताओं के लिए संदर्भ की शर्तों (ToR) पर हस्ताक्षर किए। दक्षिणी अफ्रीकी सीमा शुल्क संघ (SACU) में कौन से देश शामिल हैं?
oe: South Africa, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia, and Eswatini
Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda
Egypt, Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria, and Libya
Zambia, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Angola, and Malawi
oh: दक्षिण अफ्रीका, बोत्सवाना, लेसोथो, नामीबिया और इस्वातिनी
नाइजीरिया, घाना, केन्या, तंजानिया और युगांडा
मिस्र, मोरक्को, ट्यूनीशिया, अल्जीरिया और लीबिया
जाम्बिया, जिम्बाब्वे, मोज़ाम्बिक, अंगोला और मलावी
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) comprises five member states: South Africa, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia, and Eswatini. India and SACU have signed Terms of Reference for a comprehensive Preferential Trade Agreement covering rules of origin, market access, and trade in goods.
• Option B is Incorrect as these represent East and West African economic community nations outside SACU.
• Option C is Incorrect as these are North African nations.
• Option D is Incorrect as these fall under the Southern African Development Community (SADC) regional grouping rather than the specific SACU customs territory.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the production status of natural rubber in India:
1. India is among the major global producers and consumers of natural rubber.
2. Among Indian states, Assam currently ranks third in natural rubber production.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत में प्राकृतिक रबर की उत्पादन स्थिति पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत प्राकृतिक रबर के प्रमुख वैश्विक उत्पादकों और उपभोक्ताओं में से एक है।
2. भारतीय राज्यों में, असम वर्तमान में प्राकृतिक रबर उत्पादन में तीसरे स्थान पर है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct as Assam is indeed the third-largest rubber-producing state in India.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct; India is a leading producer and consumer of natural rubber globally.
• Option C is Correct because India holds a significant position as both a major producer and consumer of natural rubber, an elastic and resilient polymer derived from rubber trees (Hevea brasiliensis). Domestically, Kerala historically holds the top spot, followed by Tripura as second, and Assam positioned as India's third-largest rubber-producing state.
• Option D is Incorrect as both statements are factually substantiated.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC), consider the following statements: 
1. It is a constitutional body established under Article 338 of the Constitution of India.
2. The Commission is empowered to investigate and monitor matters relating to the safeguards provided for the Scheduled Castes under the Constitution.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग (NCSC) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 338 के तहत स्थापित एक संवैधानिक निकाय है।
2. आयोग को संविधान के तहत अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए प्रदान किए गए सुरक्षा उपायों से संबंधित मामलों की जांच और निगरानी करने का अधिकार है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also factually correct alongside statement 1.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also a correct constitutional fact.
• Option C is Correct because the National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC) is indeed a constitutional body established under Article 338, tasked with investigating safeguards, probing specific grievances, and reviewing issues like the handling of reserved posts for SC candidates as highlighted by NCSC leadership.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements accurately reflect the constitutional mandate and powers of the NCSC.

national_questions.qe:
Consider the following features regarding the 'Vibrant Villages Programme-II':
1. It is implemented as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
2. It focuses on the comprehensive development of select villages in blocks abutting the northern border.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
'वाइब्रेंट विलेज प्रोग्राम-II' (Vibrant Villages Programme-II) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं पर विचार कीजिए:
1. इसे एक केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना (Centrally Sponsored Scheme) के रूप में क्रियान्वित किया जाता है।
2. यह उत्तरी सीमा से लगे ब्लॉकों के चुनिंदा गांवों के व्यापक विकास पर केंद्रित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because Vibrant Villages Programme-II is approved as a Central Sector Scheme, not a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
• Option B is Correct because statement 2 accurately reflects its strategic objective targeting comprehensive development of select villages in blocks abutting India's northern border with a financial outlay up to FY 2028-29.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 1 contains an error regarding the funding/implementation category (Central Sector vs Centrally Sponsored).
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is fully correct.

national_questions.qe: What is the primary foundational approach of 'PRAHAAR', India's comprehensive National Counter Terrorism Policy & Strategy?
national_questions.qh: भारत की व्यापक राष्ट्रीय आतंकवाद विरोधी नीति और रणनीति 'PRAHAAR' का प्राथमिक आधारभूत दृष्टिकोण क्या है?
oe: Strictly military-led kinetic operations and cross-border retaliation
'Whole of government' and 'whole of society' approaches
Exclusive intelligence sharing with international security agencies without domestic structural reforms
Centralized state police mobilization under direct martial law provisions
oh: विशेष रूप से सैन्य-नेतृत्व वाले काइनेटिक ऑपरेशन और सीमा पार प्रतिशोध
'सरकार का संपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण' और 'समाज का संपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण' (Whole of government and whole of society approaches)
घरेलू संरचनात्मक सुधारों के बिना अंतरराष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा एजेंसियों के साथ विशेष खुफिया जानकारी साझा करना
प्रत्यक्ष मार्शल लॉ प्रावधानों के तहत केंद्रीकृत राज्य पुलिस लामबंदी
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because PRAHAAR is a comprehensive national policy encompassing prevention and societal resilience, not merely military kinetic operations.
• Option B is Correct because PRAHAAR provides a national counter-terrorism framework based explicitly on 'whole of government' and 'whole of society' approaches to counter radicalization and terrorist activities.
• Option C is Incorrect because domestic policy formulation and holistic national integration form core components alongside international cooperation.
• Option D is Incorrect because martial law is not a foundational element of this counter-terrorism strategy.

national_questions.qe: Under the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY), what is the current financial health insurance cover provided per eligible family per year?
national_questions.qh: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (AB-PMJAY) के तहत, प्रति पात्र परिवार प्रति वर्ष प्रदान किया जाने वाला वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर कितना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect as ₹1 lakh is not the stipulated health cover under AB-PMJAY.
• Option B is Incorrect as ₹2 lakh is lower than the actual scheme provision.
• Option C is Correct because Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) provides health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empanelled private hospitals.
• Option D is Incorrect as ₹10 lakh exceeds the standard baseline coverage amount for the general AB-PMJAY scheme design.

national_questions.qe:
With respect to the structural composition and growth trends of India's agriculture and allied sectors, consider the following statements:
1. Agriculture and allied sectors provide livelihoods to nearly half of India's workforce.
2. Sub-sectors like livestock and fisheries have exhibited stagnant or negative growth rates over the past decade.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
भारत के कृषि और संबद्ध क्षेत्रों की संरचनात्मक संरचना और विकास के रुझानों के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. कृषि और संबद्ध क्षेत्र भारत के लगभग आधे कार्यबल को आजीविका प्रदान करते हैं।
2. पिछले दशक में पशुधन और मत्स्य पालन जैसे उप-क्षेत्रों में स्थिर या नकारात्मक विकास दर प्रदर्शित हुई है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because statement 1 is true (agriculture provides livelihoods to approximately 46.1 percent of India's workforce). Statement 2 is incorrect because livestock and fisheries have maintained robust and stable growth of 5-6 percent, rather than being stagnant or negative.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 2 states the exact opposite of actual high-performing sub-sector trends.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 contains factual inaccuracies regarding livestock and fisheries growth.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is accurate.

national_questions.qe: With reference to the economic perspectives on BRICS economies, consider the following statements regarding capital mobilization: 1. Public capital in emerging economies should act as a direct substitute for private investment to ensure state control. 2. BRICS economies often face structural challenges in attracting long-term private capital, requiring robust frameworks to build investor confidence. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh: ब्रिक्स अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के आर्थिक परिप्रेक्ष्य के संदर्भ में, पूंजी जुटाने से संबंधित निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. उभरती अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में सार्वजनिक पूंजी को निजी निवेश के विकल्प के रूप में कार्य करना चाहिए। 2. ब्रिक्स अर्थव्यवस्थाओं को अक्सर दीर्घकालिक निजी पूंजी आकर्षित करने में संरचनात्मक चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ता है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, not as a substitute for it, crowding in private capital rather than replacing market forces.
• Option B is Correct because Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted that BRICS economies face challenges in attracting private capital, necessitating credible long-term frameworks, stability, and predictability to build investor confidence.
• Option C is Incorrect as statement 1 is factually erroneous.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 2 is valid according to international economic discussions within BRICS forums.

national_questions.qe: In the context of reservations and governance in India, recent judicial pronouncements by the Calcutta High Court addressed the validity of OBC certificates issued under revised rules. Consider the following aspects of this legal development: 1. The controversy involved OBC-A and OBC-B classifications introduced by the state government. 2. The High Court ruling directed that holders of such invalidated certificates be categorized under the general (unreserved) category. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh: भारत में आरक्षण और शासन के संदर्भ में, कलकत्ता उच्च न्यायालय के हालिया न्यायिक निर्णयों में संशोधित नियमों के तहत जारी ओबीसी प्रमाण पत्र की वैधता का समाधान किया गया। इस कानूनी विकास के निम्नलिखित पहलुओं पर विचार कीजिए: 1. इस विवाद में राज्य सरकार द्वारा शुरू किया गया ओबीसी-ए और ओबीसी-बी वर्गीकरण शामिल था। 2. उच्च न्यायालय के फैसले निर्देश दिया कि ऐसे अमान्य प्रमाण पत्र धारकों को सामान्य (अनारक्षित) श्रेणी के अंतर्गत माना जाए। उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct as holders of these canceled certificates are treated under the general category.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding the OBC-A and OBC-B classifications.
• Option C is Correct because both statements accurately reflect the Calcutta High Court's ruling canceling certain OBC certificates issued under sub-classifications introduced in West Bengal, reverting holders to the general category.
• Option D is Incorrect because both statements are factually verified from judicial records.

national_questions.qe: Consider the following statements regarding the proposed Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS): 1. It is designed with a financial outlay to promote manufacturing, investment, and technology development across the container ecosystem. 2. The scheme aims to enhance India's maritime capabilities, logistics efficiency, and long-term trade competitiveness. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh: प्रस्तावित कंटेनर विनिर्माण सहायता योजना (CMAS) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. इसे कंटेनर पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में विनिर्माण, निवेश और प्रौद्योगिकी विकास को बढ़ावा देने के लिए वित्तीय परिव्यय के साथ तैयार किया गया है। 2. इस योजना का उद्देश्य भारत की समुद्री क्षमताओं, लॉजिस्टिक्स दक्षता और दीर्घकालिक व्यापार प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता को बढ़ाना है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because statement 2 is also correct regarding maritime capabilities and trade competitiveness.
• Option B is Incorrect because statement 1 is also correct regarding the scheme's financial outlay and ecosystem focus.
• Option C is Correct because the Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS) features a ₹10,000 crore outlay specifically aimed at bolstering maritime infrastructure, boosting domestic container manufacturing, and lowering logistics costs for Indian trade.
• Option D is Incorrect as both statements form the core objectives of the maritime logistics reform.

national_questions.qe: With reference to the 'Ayush Grid' initiative, consider the following statements: 1. It functions as a comprehensive IT backbone for the Ayush sector, aligning with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). 2. It is restricted solely to medicinal plants cultivation data and does not cover education, research, or hospital management systems. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh: 'आयुष ग्रिड' पहल के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. यह आयुष क्षेत्र के लिए एक व्यापक आईटी रीढ़ के रूप में कार्य करता है, जो आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल मिशन (ABDM) के साथ संरेखित है। 2. यह पूरी तरह से औषधीय पौधों की खेती के डेटा तक सीमित है और शिक्षा, अनुसंधान या अस्पताल प्रबंधन प्रणालियों को कवर नहीं करता है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Ayush Grid is a comprehensive IT infrastructure project for the Ayush sector that integrates healthcare, research, education, drug administration, and medicinal plants while being fully compliant with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) and featuring the Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS).
• Option B is Incorrect because the platform is not restricted solely to medicinal plants; it encompasses a wide spectrum including education, healthcare delivery, and research.
• Option C is Incorrect as statement 2 is false.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is factually accurate.

national_questions.qe: Consider the following statements regarding elephant conservation in India: 1. India legally recognizes designated Elephant Reserves distributed across various states under statutory wildlife management frameworks. 2. Elephant conservation efforts in India are solely isolated to forest departments without any linkages to broader biodiversity and ecological heritage preservation. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh: भारत में हाथी संरक्षण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए: 1. भारत वैधानिक वन्यजीव प्रबंधन ढाँचे के तहत विभिन्न राज्यों में फैلے नामित हाथी रिजर्व को कानूनी रूप से मान्यता देता है। 2. भारत में हाथी संरक्षण के प्रयास केवल वन विभागों तक ही सीमित हैं, जिनका व्यापक जैव विविधता और पारिस्थितिक विरासत संरक्षण से कोई संबंध नहीं है। उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India has established 33 Elephant Reserves across various states to protect migratory corridors and habitats, with elephant conservation being intrinsically linked to protecting overall forest health and biodiversity.
• Option B is Incorrect because elephant conservation is deeply integrated with landscape-level biodiversity protection, climate action, and ecological heritage rather than being isolated.
• Option C is Incorrect since statement 2 is invalid.
• Option D is Incorrect because statement 1 is correct.

national_questions.qe:
With reference to the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, consider the following statements:
1. The Bill seeks to amend the First Schedule of the Constitution of India to change the state's name to 'Keralam'.
2. A bill for the alteration of the name of a state requires prior recommendation of the President before being introduced in either House of Parliament.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
national_questions.qh:
केरल (नाम परिवर्तन) विधेयक के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. यह विधेयक राज्य का नाम बदलकर 'केरलम' करने के लिए भारत के संविधान की पहली अनुसूची में संशोधन करना चाहता है।
2. किसी राज्य के नाम में परिवर्तन के लिए विधेयक को संसद के किसी भी सदन में पेश करने से पहले राष्ट्रपति की पूर्व सिफारिश की आवश्यकता होती है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Statement 1 is Correct because the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 seeks to officially change the name of the state of Kerala to 'Keralam' in the First Schedule of the Constitution, following a unanimous resolution passed by the Kerala Legislative Assembly.
